english: Hello.
transliteration: nee-HAO.
translation: 您好。

english: Good morning.
transliteration: ZAO-shang-HAO.
translation: 早上好。

english: My name is ___.
transliteration: WOR jiao ___.

english: I am your doctor.
transliteration: WOR shrr NIN de ee-SHENG.
translation: 我是您的医生。

english: I am your nurse.
transliteration: WOR shrr NIN de HOO-shrr.
translation: 我是您的护士。

english: I am a medical student.
transliteration: WOR shrr ee-SHWEH-sheng.
translation: 我是医学生。

english: I am a social worker.
transliteration: WOR shrr SHER-gong.
translation: 我是社工。

english: How would you like me to address you?
transliteration: NIN shee-WANG wor zen-muh cheng-hoo NIN?
translation: 您希望我怎么称呼您？

english: How can I help you today?
transliteration: jin-TYEN wor neng way NIN zuo she-muh?
translation: 今天我能为您做些什么？

english: Thank you for speaking with me.
transliteration: SHYEH-shyeh NIN hahn wor JIAO-tahn.
translation: 谢谢您和我交谈。

english: What language do you prefer to speak?
transliteration: NIN shee-HWAN yong she-muh YEN-jing jiao-lyoo?
translation: 您喜欢用什么语言交流？

english: Would you like a professional interpreter?
transliteration: NIN SHOO-yao zhuan-YEH kow-ee-yuan ma?
translation: 您需要专业口译员吗？

english: We can call an interpreter.
transliteration: WOR-men kuh-yee da dee-HWAHN ching kow-ee-yuan.
translation: 我们可以打电话请口译员。

english: Please speak slowly.
transliteration: ching MAHN-mahn shuo.
translation: 请慢慢说。

english: Could you repeat that, please?
transliteration: ching NIN zye shuo ee-BYEN, HAO-ma?
translation: 请您再说一遍，好吗？

english: I did not understand. Could you explain again?
transliteration: WOR may ting ming-BAI. NIN neng zye jie-SHR ee-shyah ma?
translation: 我没听明白。您能再解释一下吗？

english: Please tell me if anything is unclear.
transliteration: roo-GWO yaw ren-HUH dee-fang boo ching-choo, ching GAO-soo wor.
translation: 如果有任何地方不清楚，请告诉我。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: NIN yaw she-muh wen-TI ma?
translation: 您有什么问题吗？

english: Could you explain in your own words what we discussed?
transliteration: NIN neng yong zih-JEE de HWAH shuo-shuo WOR-men gang-TSYEY tan-le she-muh ma?
translation: 您能用自己的话说说我们刚才谈了什么吗？

english: You can answer yes or no.
transliteration: NIN kuh-yee hway-DAH shrr HAW-shrr boo-shrr.
translation: 您可以回答是或不是。

english: Please point to what you mean.
transliteration: ching zhee-CHOO NIN shuo de shrr nay ee-guh.
translation: 请指出您说的是哪一个。

english: Is it okay if I ask you some questions?
transliteration: WOR kuh-yee wen NIN jee-guh wen-TI ma?
translation: 我可以问您几个问题吗？

english: Would you like someone to stay with you?
transliteration: NIN shee-WANG yaw ren PEY-zhe NIN ma?
translation: 您希望有人陪着您吗？

english: Would you prefer to speak privately?
transliteration: NIN SHYANG dan-doo tan-tan ma?
translation: 您想单独谈谈吗？

english: Is it okay if I examine you?
transliteration: WOR kuh-yee way NIN zuo jian-CHA ma?
translation: 我可以为您做检查吗？

english: Please tell me if you feel uncomfortable.
transliteration: roo-GWO NIN jyoo-dwuh boo SHOO-foo, ching GAO-soo wor.
translation: 如果您觉得不舒服，请告诉我。

english: We can stop at any time.
transliteration: WOR-men swee-SHR kuh-yee ting-shyah-lai.
translation: 我们随时可以停下来。

english: Do you agree with this plan?
transliteration: NIN tong-YEE jeh-guh JI-hwa ma?
translation: 您同意这个计划吗？

english: Would you like more time to decide?
transliteration: NIN SHYANG dwoh HWAH shyay SHRR-jyan kao-LYOO ma?
translation: 您想多花些时间考虑吗？

english: I will explain what I am doing.
transliteration: WOR hway SHYANG NIN jie-SHR wor zye zuo she-muh.
translation: 我会向您解释我在做什么。

english: What is your full name?
transliteration: NIN de chwan-MING shrr she-muh?
translation: 您的全名是什么？

english: What is your date of birth?
transliteration: NIN de choo-SHENG ree-CHEE shrr she-muh?
translation: 您的出生日期是什么？

english: How old are you?
transliteration: NIN dwoh DAH le?
translation: 您多大了？

english: What is your phone number?
transliteration: NIN de dee-HWAHN-HAO-mah shrr dwoh-SHAO?
translation: 您的电话号码是多少？

english: What is your address?
transliteration: NIN de zhoo-JEE shrr she-muh?
translation: 您的住址是什么？

english: Who is your emergency contact?
transliteration: NIN de jin-JEE lian-SHIH-ren shrr shey?
translation: 您的紧急联系人是谁？

english: Do you have a family doctor?
transliteration: NIN yaw jya-TING ee-SHENG ma?
translation: 您有家庭医生吗？

english: What pharmacy do you use?
transliteration: NIN ping-SHR zay nay-jyah YAO-fang peih-YAO?
translation: 您平时在哪家药房配药？

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: NIN jin-TYEN way-SHEN-muh lai-kan-BING?
translation: 您今天为什么来看病？

english: What is your main concern?
transliteration: NIN zway dan-SHIN de shrr she-muh?
translation: 您最担心的是什么？

english: When did this problem start?
transliteration: jeh-guh wen-TI shrr she-muh SHR-hou kai-SHR de?
translation: 这个问题是什么时候开始的？

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: jeh-shrr too-RAN kai-SHR de, hair-SHR MAHN-mahn chuh-SHYEN de?
translation: 这是突然开始的，还是慢慢出现的？

english: Is it there all the time or does it come and go?
transliteration: jeh-jong qing-KWANG ee-JEE yaw, hair-SHR SHR-yow-SHR woo?
translation: 这种情况一直都有，还是时有时无？

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: qing-KWANG shrr zay HAO-jwan, jya-JONG, hair-SHR may-yow bian-HWAH?
translation: 情况是在好转、加重，还是没有变化？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: NIN ee-CHYAN yaw-gwo jeh-guh wen-TI ma?
translation: 您以前有过这个问题吗？

english: What makes it better?
transliteration: she-muh qing-KWANG hway rang NIN gan-JYAW HAO ee-SHYAH?
translation: 什么情况会让您感觉好一些？

english: What makes it worse?
transliteration: she-muh qing-KWANG hway rang NIN gan-JYAW geng-TSAO?
translation: 什么情况会让您感觉更糟？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: NIN hair yaw chyee-TAH zheng-JWANG ma?
translation: 您还有其他症状吗？

english: How is this affecting your daily life?
transliteration: jeh duee NIN de ree-CHANG sheng-HWO yaw she-muh ying-SHYANG?
translation: 这对您的日常生活有什么影响？

english: Where does it hurt?
transliteration: NIN nay-LEE teng?
translation: 您哪里疼？

english: Can you point to where it hurts?
transliteration: NIN neng zhee-CHOO teng-TONG de dee-fang ma?
translation: 您能指出疼痛的地方吗？

english: Does the pain spread anywhere else?
transliteration: teng-TONG hway kuo-SAN dao byeh de dee-fang ma?
translation: 疼痛会扩散到别的地方吗？

english: What does the pain feel like?
transliteration: NIN de teng-TONG shrr she-muh gan-JYAW?
translation: 您的疼痛是什么感觉？

english: Is it sharp, dull, burning, or cramping?
transliteration: teng-TONG shrr tsih-TONG, doon-TONG, JWAH-tong, hair-SHR shyang chow-JIN ee-yang?
translation: 疼痛是刺痛、钝痛、灼痛，还是像抽筋一样？

english: On a scale from zero to ten, how bad is the pain?
transliteration: roo-GWO cong LING dao SHRR da-FEN, NIN de teng-TONG yaw dwoh yen-JONG?
translation: 如果从零到十打分，您的疼痛有多严重？

english: Does it hurt when I touch here?
transliteration: WOR pong jeh-LEE shr, NIN hway teng ma?
translation: 我碰这里时，您会疼吗？

english: Does the pain wake you from sleep?
transliteration: teng-TONG hway bah NIN tong-XING ma?
translation: 疼痛会把您痛醒吗？

english: Is the pain different from before?
transliteration: shyan-ZAY de teng-TONG her ee-CHYAN boo ee-YANG ma?
translation: 现在的疼痛和以前不一样吗？

english: Do you have any long-term medical conditions?
transliteration: NIN yaw CHANG-chi de jyan-KANG wen-TI ma?
translation: 您有长期的健康问题吗？

english: Have you ever stayed in a hospital?
transliteration: NIN ee-CHYAN zhoo-gwo-YUAN ma?
translation: 您以前住过院吗？

english: Have you had any operations?
transliteration: NIN zuo-gwo show-SHOO ma?
translation: 您做过手术吗？

english: When were you diagnosed?
transliteration: NIN shrr she-muh SHR-hou queh-ZHEN de?
translation: 您是什么时候确诊的？

english: Does anyone in your family have a similar condition?
transliteration: NIN de jya-ren jong yaw-ren yaw lee-SHR de bing ma?
translation: 您的家人中有人有类似的病吗？

english: Do you have any allergies?
transliteration: NIN yaw guo-MIN ma?
translation: 您有过敏吗？

english: Are you allergic to any medicines?
transliteration: NIN duee she-muh YAO-woo guo-MIN ma?
translation: 您对什么药物过敏吗？

english: What happens when you have that reaction?
transliteration: NIN chuh-SHYEN jeh-jong fan-YING shr hway yaw she-muh qing-KWANG?
translation: 您出现这种反应时会有什么情况？

english: Have you received your routine vaccinations?
transliteration: NIN jie-ZHONG-gwo chang-GWAY yee-MIAO ma?
translation: 您接种过常规疫苗吗？

english: What medicines do you take?
transliteration: NIN zay foo-YONG nay-shee YAO-woo?
translation: 您在服用哪些药物？

english: Can you show me your medication list?
transliteration: NIN neng gay wor-kan ee-SHYAH NIN de yong-YAO qing-DAN ma?
translation: 您能给我看一下您的用药清单吗？

english: What dose do you take?
transliteration: NIN mee-TSY duh foo-YONG dwoh-SHAO jee-LYANG?
translation: 您每次服用多少剂量？

english: How often do you take it?
transliteration: NIN dwoh-JOO foo-YONG ee-TSY?
translation: 您多久服用一次？

english: When did you last take it?
transliteration: NIN shang-TSY foo-YONG shrr she-muh SHR-hou?
translation: 您上次服用是什么时候？

english: Have you started any new medicines?
transliteration: NIN zway-JIN kai-SHR foo-YONG shin-YAO le ma?
translation: 您最近开始服用新药了吗？

english: Have you stopped taking any medicines?
transliteration: NIN ting-JEE foo-YONG-gwo she-muh YAO ma?
translation: 您停止服用过什么药吗？

english: Have you missed any doses?
transliteration: NIN yaw loo-FOO-gwo YAO ma?
translation: 您有漏服过药吗？

english: Do you take vitamins or herbal remedies?
transliteration: NIN foo-YONG way-sheng-SOO how-tsao ma?
translation: 您服用维生素或草药吗？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: NIN joo-YEE dao yaw she-muh fuh-ZOO ma?
translation: 您注意到有什么副作用吗？

english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: NIN her shey zhoo-zay ee-QEE?
translation: 您和谁住在一起？

english: Do you have someone who can help you at home?
transliteration: NIN zay-jya yaw kuh-yee bang NIN de ren ma?
translation: 您在家有可以帮您的人吗？

english: Do you feel safe at home?
transliteration: NIN zay-jya gan-JYAW an-CHWAN ma?
translation: 您在家觉得安全吗？

english: Do you need help with everyday activities?
transliteration: NIN SHOO-yao byeh-ren bang-MANG zuo ree-CHANG hoo-DONG ma?
translation: 您需要别人帮忙做日常活动吗？

english: Do you have reliable transportation to appointments?
transliteration: NIN yaw kuh-KAO de jiao-TONG fang-SHR choo-jian-ZHEN ma?
translation: 您有可靠的交通方式去就诊吗？

english: Do you have trouble paying for medicines?
transliteration: NIN jiao YAO-fee yaw kun-NAN ma?
translation: 您支付药费有困难吗？

english: Do you have a stable place to live?
transliteration: NIN yaw wen-DING de zhoo-SHOO ma?
translation: 您有稳定的住所吗？

english: What kind of work do you do?
transliteration: NIN zuo she-muh gong-ZUO?
translation: 您做什么工作？

english: Do you need a medical note for work or school?
transliteration: NIN SHOO-yao ee-FEN gay gong-ZUO dan-WEE how-SHYOW de yee-LYAO zheng-MING ma?
translation: 您需要一份给工作单位或学校的医疗证明吗？

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: ching zuo zay jeh-LEE.
translation: 请坐在这里。

english: Please lie down.
transliteration: ching tang-SHYAH.
translation: 请躺下。

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: ching tseh-SHEN tang.
translation: 请侧身躺。

english: Please stand up slowly.
transliteration: ching MAHN-mahn zhan-CHI-lai.
translation: 请慢慢站起来。

english: Please stay still for a moment.
transliteration: ching SHAO-deng pyen-KEH, bao-CHRR boo-DONG.
translation: 请稍等片刻，保持不动。

english: Please take a deep breath.
transliteration: ching SHEN shee ee-KOW-chee.
translation: 请深吸一口气。

english: Please breathe normally.
transliteration: ching zheng-CHANG hoo-SHEE.
translation: 请正常呼吸。

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: roo-GWO yaw ren-HUH dee-fang teng, ching GAO-soo wor.
translation: 如果有任何地方疼，请告诉我。

english: May I check your blood pressure?
transliteration: WOR kuh-yee gay NIN lyang shee-YA ma?
translation: 我可以给您量血压吗？

english: I am going to check your temperature.
transliteration: WOR shyan-ZAY yao gay NIN lyang tee-WEN.
translation: 我现在要给您量体温。

english: We will check your height and weight.
transliteration: WOR-men yao gay NIN lyang shen-GAO, cheng tee-JONG.
translation: 我们要给您量身高、称体重。

english: You can get dressed now.
transliteration: NIN shyan-ZAY kuh-yee chwan ee-FOO le.
translation: 您现在可以穿衣服了。

english: We would like to do a blood test.
transliteration: WOR-men SHYANG gay NIN zuo shew-YEH jian-CHA.
translation: 我们想给您做血液检查。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: WOR-men SHOO-yao ee-FEN nyee-YEH yang-BEN.
translation: 我们需要一份尿液样本。

english: The test may cause brief discomfort.
transliteration: jian-CHA kuh-NENG hway rang NIN doan-ZAN gan-JYAW boo SHOO-foo.
translation: 检查可能会让您短暂感到不舒服。

english: The results are not ready yet.
transliteration: jie-GWO hair may-yow chuh-LAI.
translation: 结果还没有出来。

english: The test results are normal.
transliteration: jian-CHA jie-GWO zheng-CHANG.
translation: 检查结果正常。

english: The test results need further review.
transliteration: jian-CHA jie-GWO hair SHOO-yao jin-EE-boo ping-GOO.
translation: 检查结果还需要进一步评估。

english: We may need more tests.
transliteration: WOR-men kuh-NENG hair SHOO-yao zuo ee-shee jian-CHA.
translation: 我们可能还需要做一些检查。

english: We will explain the results to you.
transliteration: WOR-men hway SHYANG NIN jie-SHR jian-CHA jie-GWO.
translation: 我们会向您解释检查结果。

english: There are several treatment options.
transliteration: yaw jee-jong jrr-LYAO fang-AN kuh gong SHUAN-zuh.
translation: 有几种治疗方案可供选择。

english: I would like to explain the benefits and risks.
transliteration: WOR SHYANG SHYANG NIN shwo-MING jrr-LYAO de HAO-choo her feng-XIAN.
translation: 我想向您说明治疗的好处和风险。

english: What matters most to you in choosing treatment?
transliteration: SHUAN-zuh jrr-LYAO fang-AN shr, NIN zway zhong-KAN she-muh?
translation: 选择治疗方案时，您最看重什么？

english: This treatment may take time to work.
transliteration: jeh-jong jrr-LYAO kuh-NENG SHOO-yao ee-DWAN SHR-jyan tsai hway jian-XIAO.
translation: 这种治疗可能需要一段时间才会见效。

english: Please take the medicine as prescribed.
transliteration: ching an yee-JOO foo-YAO.
translation: 请按医嘱服药。

english: Please do not change the dose without medical advice.
transliteration: way-JING ee-SHENG jian-YEE, ching boo-YAO gai-BIAN YAO-LYANG.
translation: 未经医生建议，请不要改变药量。

english: Please let us know if you have side effects.
transliteration: roo-GWO NIN chuh-SHYEN fuh-ZOO, ching GAO-soo WOH-men.
translation: 如果您出现副作用，请告诉我们。

english: Would you like written instructions?
transliteration: NIN SHOO-yao show-MING shwo-MING ma?
translation: 您需要书面说明吗？

english: Please wait in the waiting area.
transliteration: ching zay how-ZHEN qu ee-HOU.
translation: 请在候诊区等候。

english: The nurse will see you shortly.
transliteration: hoo-SHR hen-KWAI jyoow hway lai-kan NIN.
translation: 护士很快就会来看您。

english: The doctor will come back soon.
transliteration: ee-SHENG hen-KWAI jyoow hway hwai-LAI.
translation: 医生很快就会回来。

english: We are taking you to another room.
transliteration: WOR-men shyan-ZAY dai NIN choo ling-ee-guh fang-JYAN.
translation: 我们现在带您去另一个房间。

english: You may need to stay in the hospital.
transliteration: NIN kuh-NENG SHOO-yao zhoo-YUAN.
translation: 您可能需要住院。

english: We will observe you for a little longer.
transliteration: WOR-men hway zay GWAHN-cha NIN ee-HWAYR.
translation: 我们会再观察您一会儿。

english: You can go home today.
transliteration: NIN jin-TYEN kuh-yee hwai-JYA.
translation: 您今天可以回家。

english: Where is your appointment scheduled?
transliteration: NIN de yueh-JEN an-PAI zay nay-LEE?
translation: 您的预约安排在哪里？

english: Please bring your medication list next time.
transliteration: shyah-TSY ching dai-shang NIN de yong-YAO qing-DAN.
translation: 下次请带上您的用药清单。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: WOR-men hway way NIN an-PAI foo-ZHEN.
translation: 我们会为您安排复诊。

english: Please follow up with your family doctor.
transliteration: ching lian-XI NIN de jya-TING ee-SHENG foo-ZHEN.
translation: 请联系您的家庭医生复诊。

english: We will contact you about the results.
transliteration: WOR-men hway lian-XI NIN, GAO-zhee jian-CHA jie-GWO.
translation: 我们会联系您，告知检查结果。

english: Please come back if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: roo-GWO NIN de zheng-JWANG jya-JONG, ching hwai-LAI jian-ZHEN.
translation: 如果您的症状加重，请回来就诊。

english: If you have a medical emergency, call emergency services.
transliteration: roo-GWO yu-DAO yee-LYAO jyi-ZHENG, ching boo-DAH jyi-JYOW dee-HWAHN.
translation: 如果遇到医疗急症，请拨打急救电话。

english: Do you understand the next steps?
transliteration: NIN ming-BAI jie-shyah-LAI yao zuo she-muh ma?
translation: 您明白接下来要做什么吗？

english: Is there anything else you would like to discuss?
transliteration: NIN hair yaw chyee-TAH SHYANG tao-LUN de she-qing ma?
translation: 您还有其他想讨论的事情吗？

english: Thank you. Take care.
transliteration: SHYEH-shyeh NIN. ching bao-ZHONG.
translation: 谢谢您。请保重。

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: nee-HAO, wor shrr NIN de yee-LYAO team de ee-MING.
translation: 您好，我是您的医疗团队的一员。

english: What brought you to the hospital today?
transliteration: jin-TYEN shrr she-muh yuan-YIN rang NIN lai yee-YUAN?
translation: 今天是什么原因让您来医院？

english: What is worrying you the most?
transliteration: NIN zway dan-SHIN she-muh?
translation: 您最担心什么？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your heart.
transliteration: WOR SHYANG wen NIN ee-shee gwan-YU sheen-ZANG de wen-TI.
translation: 我想问您一些关于心脏的问题。

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: WOR kuh-yee way NIN zuo jian-CHA ma?
translation: 我可以为您做检查吗？

english: Please tell me if you feel uncomfortable.
transliteration: roo-GWO NIN jyoo-dwuh boo SHOO-foo, ching GAO-soo wor.
translation: 如果您觉得不舒服，请告诉我。

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: NIN SHOO-yao kow-ee-yuan ma?

english: I am going to check your blood pressure.
transliteration: wor shyen-zai yaow gey nuh lyang shyweh-yaang.

english: I am going to check your pulse.

english: Please sit comfortably.

english: Please lie down on your back.

english: I am going to listen to your lungs.
transliteration: wor shyen-zai yaow ting-ting nuh-der fei-boo.
translation: 我现在要听听您的肺部。

english: I am going to check for swelling in your legs.
transliteration: wor shyen-zai yaow jian-cha nuh-der tyui yoo-may-yoo jong.
translation: 我现在要检查您的腿有没有肿。

english: I am going to press gently on your abdomen.
transliteration: wor shyen-zai yaow ching-ching an-ya nuh-der foo-boo.
translation: 我现在要轻轻按压您的腹部。

english: Please turn onto your left side.
transliteration: ching nuh jwan-shyang joo-tsay.
translation: 请您转向左侧躺。

english: Please sit up.
transliteration: ching nuh dzwoh-chee-lai.
translation: 请您坐起来。

english: We need to do an ECG to record your heart rhythm.
transliteration: wor-men shoo-yaow gey nuh dzwoh shing-dyen-too, jee-loo nuh-der shing-lyoo.
translation: 我们需要给您做心电图，记录您的心律。

english: We need to take some blood tests.
transliteration: wor-men shoo-yaow gey nuh dzwoh ee-shyeh shyweh-yay jian-cha.
translation: 我们需要给您做一些血液检查。

english: We are checking for signs of heart muscle damage.
transliteration: wor-men jeng-zai jian-cha shyr-foo yoo shing-jin shoon-shang-der jee-jyaw.
translation: 我们正在检查是否有心肌损伤的迹象。

english: We would like to do an ultrasound of your heart.
transliteration: wor-men shyang gey nuh dzwoh shing-jang chao-sheng jian-cha.
translation: 我们想给您做心脏超声检查。

english: This test is called an echocardiogram.
transliteration: jay-shyang jian-cha jyaow chao-sheng shing-dong-too.
translation: 这项检查叫超声心动图。

english: You may need to wear a heart monitor.
transliteration: nuh kuh-neng shoo-yaow dai-shang shing-jang jian-tsay-ee.
translation: 您可能需要戴上心脏监测仪。

english: We may need a chest X-ray.
transliteration: wor-men kuh-neng shoo-yaow gey nuh pah shyung-boo eks-guang-pyan.
translation: 我们可能需要给您拍胸部X光片。

english: We may need a CT scan.
transliteration: wor-men kuh-neng shoo-yaow gey nuh dzwoh see-tee sao-myao.
translation: 我们可能需要给您做CT扫描。

english: We may need to do a stress test.
transliteration: wor-men kuh-neng shoo-yaow gey nuh dzwoh yoon-dong foo-hoh shyr-yen.
translation: 我们可能需要给您做运动负荷试验。

english: We may need to examine the arteries of your heart.
transliteration: wor-men kuh-neng shoo-yaow jian-cha nuh shing-jang-der dong-mai.
translation: 我们可能需要检查您心脏的动脉。

english: We are going to give you oxygen if you need it.
transliteration: roo-gwoh nuh shoo-yaow, wor-men hway gey nuh shee-yang.
translation: 如果您需要，我们会给您吸氧。

english: We need to put a small tube into a vein.
transliteration: wor-men shoo-yaow bah ee-gen shyaw-guan-dzuh fang-jin nuh-der jing-mai-lee.
translation: 我们需要把一根小管子放进您的静脉里。

english: We will give you medicine for your symptoms.
transliteration: wor-men hway gey nuh yong-yao-lai hwahn-jyeh jheng-jwang.
translation: 我们会给您用药来缓解症状。

english: We need to monitor your heart rhythm.
transliteration: wor-men shoo-yaow jian-tsay nuh-der shing-lyoo.
translation: 我们需要监测您的心律。

english: A cardiologist will assess you.
transliteration: shing-jang juan-koh ee-sheng hway way nuh ping-goo.
translation: 心脏专科医生会为您评估。

english: You may need to stay in hospital for monitoring.
transliteration: nuh kuh-neng shoo-yaow loo-zai yee-yuan jie-show jian-tsay.
translation: 您可能需要留在医院接受监测。

english: We will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.
transliteration: dzwoh ren-huh show-shoo hwor tsow-zoh chyen, wor-men doh hway syang nuh shway-ming hao-choo her feng-shyen.
translation: 做任何手术或操作前，我们都会向您说明好处和风险。

english: Do you have any questions about the procedure?
transliteration: nuh duh jay-shyang tsow-zoh yoo shee-mah wun-ty mah?
translation: 您对这项操作有什么问题吗？

english: I will explain what we have found so far.
transliteration: wor hway syang nuh shway-ming moo-chyen wor-men fah-shyen-der ching-kwang.
translation: 我会向您说明目前我们发现的情况。

english: We are still waiting for some test results.
transliteration: wor-men hai zai deng ee-shyeh jian-cha jie-gwoh.
translation: 我们还在等一些检查结果。

english: Please seek urgent help if chest pain or severe breathlessness returns.
transliteration: roo-gwoh shyung-tong hwor yan-zhong chee-dwan dzai-chee-chyen, ching lee-jyr shun-choo bang-joo.
translation: 如果胸痛或严重气短再次出现，请立即寻求帮助。

english: Please take your medicines as prescribed.
transliteration: ching an chuu-fang foo-yao.
translation: 请按处方服药。

english: Please bring your medicines to your next appointment.
transliteration: shyah-chee kan-jian-shyr, ching dai-shang nuh-der-yao.
translation: 下次看诊时，请带上您的药。

english: We will arrange follow-up with your doctor.
transliteration: wor-men hway an-pai nuh yway jian-ee-sheng foo-jian.
translation: 我们会安排您与医生复诊。

english: Do you have any questions or concerns?
transliteration: nuh yoo shee-mah wun-ty hwor goo-lyoo mah?
translation: 您有什么问题或顾虑吗？

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: nee-how, wor shyr nuh-der yee-lyaw twan-doo cheng-yuan.
translation: 您好，我是您的医疗团队成员。

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: nuh jin-tyan way-shee-mah-lai jay-lee?
translation: 您今天为什么来这里？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your breathing.
transliteration: wor shyang wun nuh ee-shyeh yoo-guan hoo-shee-der wun-ty.
translation: 我想问您一些有关呼吸的问题。

english: What is worrying you the most?
transliteration: nuh zway dan-shin shee-mah?
translation: 您最担心什么？

english: May I examine your chest and lungs?
transliteration: wor kuh-yee jian-cha ee-shyah nuh-der shyung-boo her fei-boo mah?
translation: 我可以检查一下您的胸部和肺部吗？

english: Please tell me if you feel uncomfortable.
transliteration: roo-gwoh nuh jyoo-der boo shoo-foo, ching gahw-soo wor.
translation: 如果您觉得不舒服，请告诉我。

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: nuh shoo-yaow kow-yee-yuan mah?
translation: 您需要口译员吗？

english: When did your breathing problems begin?
transliteration: nuh-der hoo-shee wun-ty shyr shee-mah-shyr-how kaish-der?
translation: 您的呼吸问题是什么时候开始的？

english: Did the problem start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: jay-guh wun-ty shyr doo-ran kaish-der, hai-shyr man-man kaish-der?
translation: 这个问题是突然开始的，还是慢慢开始的？

english: How long have you had these symptoms?
transliteration: nuh yoo jay-shee jheng-jwang doh-jew-ler?
translation: 您有这些症状多久了？

english: Are your symptoms getting better or worse?
transliteration: nuh-der jheng-jwang shyr-zai how-jwan hai-shyr jia-jhong?
translation: 您的症状是在好转还是加重？

english: Do the symptoms come and go?
transliteration: jay-shee jheng-jwang hway shyr-yoo-shyr-woo mah?
translation: 这些症状会时有时无吗？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: nuh ee-chyen yoo-gwoh jay-guh wun-ty mah?
translation: 您以前有过这个问题吗？

english: Did your symptoms begin after a cold or infection?
transliteration: nuh-der jheng-jwang shyr zai gan-mao hwor gan-ran how kaish-der mah?
translation: 您的症状是在感冒或感染后开始的吗？

english: What were you doing when the symptoms began?
transliteration: jheng-jwang kaish-shyr, nuh jeng-zai dzwoh shee-mah?
translation: 症状开始时，您正在做什么？

english: Do you have a cough?
transliteration: nuh koh-sow mah?
translation: 您咳嗽吗？

english: How long have you been coughing?
transliteration: nuh koh-sow doh-jew-ler?
translation: 您咳嗽多久了？

english: Is your cough dry or do you bring up mucus?
transliteration: nuh-der koh-sow shyr gan-koh, hai-shyr hway koh-choo tan?
translation: 您的咳嗽是干咳，还是会咳出痰？

english: Is your cough worse in the morning?
transliteration: nuh zao-shang koh-sow hway geng yan-zhong mah?
translation: 您早上咳嗽会更严重吗？

english: Is your cough worse at night?
transliteration: nuh wan-shang koh-sow hway geng yan-zhong mah?
translation: 您晚上咳嗽会更严重吗？

english: Does coughing wake you from sleep?
transliteration: koh-sow hway bah nuh koh-shing mah?
translation: 咳嗽会把您咳醒吗？

english: Does exercise make you cough?
transliteration: yoon-dong hway rang nuh koh-sow mah?
translation: 运动会让您咳嗽吗？

english: Does cold air make you cough?
transliteration: leng kong-chee hway rang nuh koh-sow mah?
translation: 冷空气会让您咳嗽吗？

english: Does lying down make your cough worse?
transliteration: tang-shyah hway rang nuh-der koh-sow jia-jhong mah?
translation: 躺下会让您的咳嗽加重吗？

english: Do you cough so hard that you vomit?
transliteration: nuh hway koh-der hen lee-hai, shen-jyr ow-too mah?
translation: 您会咳得很厉害，甚至呕吐吗？

english: Is the cough improving or worsening?
transliteration: nuh-der koh-sow shyr-zai how-jwan hai-shyr jia-jhong?
translation: 您的咳嗽是在好转还是加重？

english: Do you cough up phlegm or mucus?
transliteration: nuh hway koh-choo tan mah?
translation: 您会咳出痰吗？

english: What colour is the phlegm?
transliteration: tan shyr shee-mah yan-suh-der?
translation: 痰是什么颜色的？

english: Is the phlegm clear, white, yellow, or green?
transliteration: tan shyr tow-ming, bai-suh, huang-suh hai-shyr lyoo-suh-der?
translation: 痰是透明、白色、黄色还是绿色的？

english: How much phlegm do you bring up?
transliteration: nuh mey-chee neng koh-choo doh-shaw tan?
translation: 您每次能咳出多少痰？

english: Is the phlegm thick or thin?
transliteration: tan shyr chow hai-shyr shee-der?
translation: 痰是稠还是稀？

english: Have you noticed blood in your phlegm?
transliteration: nuh jyoo-yee-doh tan-lee yoo shyweh mah?
translation: 您注意到痰里有血吗？

english: Are you coughing up bright red blood?
transliteration: nuh koh-choo-der shyr shyen-hong-suh-der shyweh mah?
translation: 您咳出的是鲜红色的血吗？

english: How much blood have you coughed up?
transliteration: nuh koh-choo-ler doh-shaw shyweh?
translation: 您咳出了多少血？

english: Are you having trouble breathing right now?
transliteration: nuh shyen-zai hoo-shee kun-nan mah?
translation: 您现在呼吸困难吗？

english: Do you feel short of breath at rest?
transliteration: nuh joe-shyr yay hway jyoo-der chee-dwan mah?
translation: 您休息时也会觉得气短吗？

english: Does walking make you short of breath?
transliteration: zoh-loo hway rang nuh jyoo-der chee-dwan mah?
translation: 走路会让您觉得气短吗？

english: Can you climb a flight of stairs without stopping?
transliteration: nuh neng boo ting-shyah-lai, ee-kow-chee pa-wan ee-dwan low-ty mah?
translation: 您能不停下来，一口气爬完一段楼梯吗？

english: How far can you walk before you need to stop?
transliteration: nuh zoh doh-yuan jyoow shoo-yaow ting-shyah-lai shyo-see?
translation: 您走多远就需要停下来休息？

english: Is it harder to breathe when you lie flat?
transliteration: ping-tang-shyr nuh hway jyoo-der hoo-shee geng kun-nan mah?
translation: 平躺时您会觉得呼吸更困难吗？

english: Do you wake up at night struggling to breathe?
transliteration: nuh hway zai yee-lee shing-lai, jyoo-der chwan-boo-gwoh-chee mah?
translation: 您会在夜里醒来，觉得喘不过气吗？

english: Do you feel you cannot take a full breath?
transliteration: nuh jyoo-der dzuh-jee may-bahn-fah shen-shee ee-kow-chee mah?
translation: 您觉得自己没办法深吸一口气吗？

english: Do you hear a whistling sound when breathing?
transliteration: nuh hoo-shee-shyr hway ting-doh shao-dzuh ee-yang-der sheng-yin mah?
translation: 您呼吸时会听到哨子一样的声音吗？

english: Does your chest feel tight?
transliteration: nuh jyoo-der shyung-kow fah-jin mah?
translation: 您觉得胸口发紧吗？

english: Is your breathing worse than usual today?
transliteration: nuh jin-tyan-der hoo-shee bee ping-shyr geng kun-nan mah?
translation: 您今天的呼吸比平时更困难吗？

english: Do you have chest pain?
transliteration: nuh shyung-kow teng mah?
translation: 您胸口疼吗？

english: Does it hurt when you take a deep breath?
transliteration: shen-shee-chee-shyr hway teng mah?
translation: 深吸气时会疼吗？

english: Does coughing make the chest pain worse?
transliteration: koh-sow hway rang shyung-tong jia-jhong mah?
translation: 咳嗽会让胸痛加重吗？

english: Where exactly does it hurt?
transliteration: joo-ty shyr nah-lee teng?
translation: 具体是哪里疼？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: nuh fah-shao hwor fah-leng mah?
translation: 您发烧或发冷吗？

english: Have you been sweating at night?
transliteration: nuh wan-shang shway-jyaow-shyr chow-han mah?
translation: 您晚上睡觉时出汗吗？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: nuh yoo-may-yoo ke-yee jiang-jhong-der ching-kwang-shyah show-shya-le?
translation: 您有没有在没有刻意减重的情况下瘦下来？

english: Are you more tired than usual?
transliteration: nuh bee ping-shyr geng rong-yee jyoo-der lee mah?
translation: 您比平时更容易觉得累吗？

english: Do you have a runny or blocked nose?
transliteration: nuh lyoow-bi hwor bih-sai mah?
translation: 您流鼻涕或鼻塞吗？

english: Has your voice changed or become hoarse?
transliteration: nuh-der sheng-yin byan-ler hwor byan-der shyr-ya mah?
translation: 您的声音变了或变得嘶哑了吗？

english: Are you struggling to speak because of breathlessness?
transliteration: nuh hway yin-wei chee-dwan er shway-hwah kun-nan mah?
translation: 您会因为气短而说话困难吗？

english: Did your breathing difficulty start very suddenly?
transliteration: nuh-der hoo-shee kun-nan shyr doo-ran kaish-der mah?
translation: 您的呼吸困难是突然开始的吗？

english: Have you fainted or felt about to faint?
transliteration: nuh hyun-dao-gwoh, hwor jyoo-der dzuh-jee kwai-yao hyun-dao ler mah?
translation: 您昏倒过，或觉得自己快要昏倒了吗？

english: Have your lips or fingers turned blue?
transliteration: nuh-der zoo-chun hwor show-jee fah-ching ler mah?
translation: 您的嘴唇或手指发青了吗？

english: Do you have severe chest pain right now?
transliteration: nuh shyen-zai shyung-kow jyoo-lee teng-tong mah?
translation: 您现在胸口剧烈疼痛吗？

english: Have you had swelling or pain in one leg?
transliteration: nuh yoo-gwoh ee-tyao tyui jong-jang hwor teng-tong mah?
translation: 您有过一条腿肿胀或疼痛吗？

english: Have you recently had surgery or been on a long journey?
transliteration: nuh jee-gun dzwoh-gwoh show-shoo hwor chang-too luh-shing mah?
translation: 您最近做过手术或长途旅行吗？

english: Have you had swelling of your face or tongue?
transliteration: nuh-der lian hwor shyr-tow jong-gwoh mah?
translation: 您的脸或舌头肿过吗？

english: Did you inhale smoke, fumes, or chemicals?
transliteration: nuh shee-yoo-goo yan, yan-woo hwor hwa-shway-wuh mah?
translation: 您吸入过烟、烟雾或化学物质吗？

english: Have you ever been diagnosed with asthma?
transliteration: nuh ee-chyen bay jian-dwan-gwoh xiao-chuan mah?
translation: 您以前被诊断过哮喘吗？

english: Do you have episodes of wheezing?
transliteration: nuh hway jian-duan-shing-de chwan-ming mah?
translation: 您会间歇性地喘鸣吗？

english: Do dust, pollen, or pets trigger your symptoms?
transliteration: hwei-ty, hua-fen hwor chong-wuh hway yin-fah nuh-der jheng-jwang mah?
translation: 灰尘、花粉或宠物会引发您的症状吗？

english: Does exercise trigger your breathing problems?
transliteration: yoon-dong hway yin-fah nuh-der hoo-shee wun-ty mah?
translation: 运动会引发您的呼吸问题吗？

english: Have you ever needed emergency treatment for asthma?
transliteration: nuh ee-chyen yin-wei xiao-chuan jie-show-gwoh ji-jian-chu-lee mah?
translation: 您以前因哮喘接受过急诊治疗吗？

english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for asthma?
transliteration: nuh ee-chyen yin-wei xiao-chuan joo-gwoh-yuan mah?
translation: 您以前因哮喘住过院吗？

english: Do you have eczema or seasonal allergies?
transliteration: nuh yoo shyr-jhen hwor jee-jyeh-shing gwoh-min mah?
translation: 您有湿疹或季节性过敏吗？

english: Have you had a serious allergic reaction?
transliteration: nuh yoo-gwoh yan-zhong-der gwoh-min fan-ying mah?
translation: 您有过严重的过敏反应吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with COPD or emphysema?
transliteration: nuh bay jian-dwan-gwoh man-shing zhoo-sai-shing fei-bing (COPD) hwor fei-qi-jhong mah?
translation: 您被诊断过慢性阻塞性肺病（COPD）或肺气肿吗？

english: Do you have chronic bronchitis?
transliteration: nuh yoo man-shing jhy-guan-yan mah?
translation: 您有慢性支气管炎吗？

english: Do you have a cough most days?
transliteration: nuh dah-doo-shoo reh-dzuh doh hway koh-sow mah?
translation: 您大多数日子都会咳嗽吗？

english: Do you often have flare-ups of your lung condition?
transliteration: nuh-der fei-boo bing jing-chang fah-tsoh mah?
translation: 您的肺部疾病经常发作吗？

english: Have you needed steroids or antibiotics for breathing flare-ups?
transliteration: nuh-der hoo-shee wun-ty fah-tsoh-shyr, shoo-yaow yong lei-goo-choon-yao-woo hwor kang-sheng-soo mah?
translation: 您的呼吸问题发作时，需要用类固醇药物或抗生素吗？

english: Do you use oxygen at home?
transliteration: nuh zai jyah shyroo-yong yang-chee mah?
translation: 您在家使用氧气吗？

english: Have you ever had a collapsed lung?
transliteration: nuh-der fei ee-chyen tah-shyan-gwoh mah?
translation: 您的肺以前塌陷过吗？

english: Have you ever had a blood clot in your lungs?
transliteration: nuh-der fei-boo ee-chyen yoo-gwoh shyweh-shwan mah?
translation: 您的肺部以前有过血栓吗？

english: Have you recently had a chest infection?
transliteration: nuh jee-gun deh-gwoh shyung-boo gan-ran mah?
translation: 您最近得过胸部感染吗？

english: Have you ever had pneumonia?
transliteration: nuh ee-chyen deh-gwoh fei-yan mah?
translation: 您以前得过肺炎吗？

english: Have you ever had tuberculosis, also called TB?
transliteration: nuh ee-chyen deh-gwoh jeh-he bing (TB) mah?
translation: 您以前得过结核病（TB）吗？

english: Have you been in close contact with someone with TB?
transliteration: nuh tseng yway jie-he bing-huan-jay yoo-gwoh mee-chee jie-chu mah?
translation: 您曾与结核病患者有过密切接触吗？

english: Have you been coughing for more than three weeks?
transliteration: nuh koh-sow chao-gwoh san-joo-ler mah?
translation: 您咳嗽超过三周了吗？

english: Have you had fever, night sweats, or weight loss?
transliteration: nuh fah-gwoh-shao, yee-jyan hahn hwor tyoo-jhong jian-ching mah?
translation: 您发过烧、夜间出汗或体重减轻吗？

english: Have you taken medication to treat TB?
transliteration: nuh foo-yong-gwoh jyoo-lyaw jeh-he bing-der-yao-woo mah?
translation: 您服用过治疗结核病的药物吗？

english: Have you completed your TB treatment?
transliteration: nuh wan-cheng jeh-he bing jyoo-lyaw ler mah?
translation: 您完成结核病治疗了吗？

english: Has anyone at home been coughing recently?
transliteration: nuh jyah-lee jee-gun yoo-ren koh-sow mah?
translation: 您家里最近有人咳嗽吗？

english: Do you currently smoke cigarettes?
transliteration: nuh shyen-zai shee-yan mah?
translation: 您现在吸烟吗？

english: Have you smoked in the past?
transliteration: nuh ee-chyen shee-gwoh-yan mah?
translation: 您以前吸过烟吗？

english: How many cigarettes do you smoke per day?
transliteration: nuh mey-tyan shee doh-shaw jee-yan?
translation: 您每天吸多少支烟？

english: For how many years have you smoked?
transliteration: nuh shee-yan doh-shaw nyan-ler?
translation: 您吸烟多少年了？

english: When did you quit smoking?
transliteration: nuh shee-mah-shyr-how jee-yan-der?
translation: 您什么时候戒烟的？

english: Do you vape or use electronic cigarettes?
transliteration: nuh shyroo-yong dyen-dzuh-yan mah?
translation: 您使用电子烟吗？

english: Are you exposed to cigarette smoke at home?
transliteration: nuh zai jyah hway jie-chu-dao shyang-yan yan-woo mah?
translation: 您在家会接触到香烟烟雾吗？

english: Are you exposed to dust, fumes, or chemicals at work?
transliteration: nuh zai gong-zoh-shyr hway jie-chu-dao hwei-ty, yan-woo hwor hwa-shway-wuh mah?
translation: 您在工作时会接触到灰尘、烟雾或化学物质吗？

english: Have you been exposed to asbestos?
transliteration: nuh jie-chu-gwoh shyr-mian mah?
translation: 您接触过石棉吗？

english: Do you use a wood stove or indoor fire for cooking or heating?
transliteration: nuh hway yong chai-loo hwor shyr-ney how-yuan dzwoh-fan hwor chyoo-nuan mah?
translation: 您会用柴炉或室内火源做饭或取暖吗？

english: Do you snore loudly?
transliteration: nuh dah-lu sheng-yin hen dah mah?
translation: 您打鼾声音很大吗？

english: Has anyone noticed that you stop breathing during sleep?
transliteration: yoo-ren jyoo-yee-doh nuh shway-jyaow-shyr hway ting-jyr hoo-shee mah?
translation: 有人注意到您睡觉时会停止呼吸吗？

english: Do you wake up gasping or choking?
transliteration: nuh hway doo-ran shing-lai, dah-kow chwan-chee hwor shyang bay yeh-joo ee-yang mah?
translation: 您会突然醒来，大口喘气或像被噎住一样吗？

english: Do you feel sleepy during the day?
transliteration: nuh bai-tyan hway jyoo-der kun mah?
translation: 您白天会觉得困吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with sleep apnea?
transliteration: nuh bay jian-dwan-gwoh shway-mian hoo-shee tsan-ting mah?
translation: 您被诊断过睡眠呼吸暂停吗？

english: Do you use a CPAP machine at night?
transliteration: nuh wan-shang shyroo-yong CPAP hoo-shee-jee mah?
translation: 您晚上使用 CPAP 呼吸机吗？

english: Do you have trouble using your CPAP mask?
transliteration: nuh shyroo-yong CPAP mian-zhao yoo kun-nan mah?
translation: 您使用 CPAP 面罩有困难吗？

english: What medicines do you take for your breathing?
transliteration: nuh yong nah-shyeh yao-lai jyoo-lyaw hoo-shee wun-ty?
translation: 您用哪些药来治疗呼吸问题？

english: Do you use an inhaler?
transliteration: nuh shyroo-yong shee-yin-cher mah?
translation: 您使用吸入器吗？

english: Which inhalers do you use?
transliteration: nuh shyroo-yong nah-shyeh shee-yin-cher?
translation: 您使用哪些吸入器？

english: How many times a day do you use your inhaler?
transliteration: nuh mey-tyan shyroo-yong shee-yin-cher jee-chee?
translation: 您每天使用吸入器几次？

english: When did you last use your inhaler?
transliteration: nuh shyang-chee shyroo-yong shee-yin-cher shyr shee-mah-shyr-how?
translation: 您上次使用吸入器是什么时候？

english: Does your inhaler help your breathing?
transliteration: shee-yin-cher neng bang-joo nuh gai-shan hoo-shee mah?
translation: 吸入器能帮助您改善呼吸吗？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: nuh jee-gun loo-foo-gwoh-yao mah?
translation: 您最近漏服过药吗？

english: Do you use a spacer with your inhaler?
transliteration: nuh shyroo-yong shee-yin-cher-shyr hway pei-her chuu-wuu-guan mah?
translation: 您使用吸入器时会配合储雾罐吗？

english: Can you show me how you use your inhaler?
transliteration: nuh neng gey wor yan-shr ee-shyah zen-ma shyroo-yong shee-yin-cher mah?
translation: 您能给我演示一下怎么使用吸入器吗？

english: Do you rinse your mouth after using your steroid inhaler?
transliteration: nuh shyroo-yong lei-goo-choon-shee-yin-cher how hway soo-kow mah?
translation: 您使用类固醇吸入器后会漱口吗？

english: Have you recently taken antibiotics or steroid tablets?
transliteration: nee dzway-jin foo-yong gwoh kahng-sheng-soo uh lway-goo-chwun peeahn-jee mah?
translation: 您最近服用过抗生素或类固醇片剂吗？

english: Are you allergic to any medicines?
transliteration: nee dwye shen-muh yaow-woo gwoh-min mah?
translation: 您对什么药物过敏吗？

english: Do you have any other medical conditions?
transliteration: nee hay-yow chee-tah jee-bing mah?
translation: 您还有其他疾病吗？

english: Have you ever had heart disease or heart failure?
transliteration: nee yee-chyen hwahn-gwoh shehn-dzahng-bing uh shehn-dzahng shway-jaw-lew mah?
translation: 您以前患过心脏病或心力衰竭吗？

english: Have you ever had surgery on your chest or lungs?
transliteration: nee yee-chyen dzwoh-gwoh chwung-boo uh fay-boo show-shuh mah?
translation: 您以前做过胸部或肺部手术吗？

english: Have you ever been admitted to intensive care for breathing problems?
transliteration: nee yee-chyen yin-why hoo-shee wen-tee joo-gwoh jwung-jeng jian-hoo-shr mah?
translation: 您以前因为呼吸问题住过重症监护室吗？

english: Has anyone in your family had asthma or lung disease?
transliteration: nee jya-lee yow-ren hwahn-gwoh shee-oo-chwuhn uh fay-bing mah?
translation: 您家里有人患过哮喘或肺病吗？

english: Has anyone in your family had lung cancer?
transliteration: nee jya-lee yow-ren hwahn-gwoh fay-ahn mah?
translation: 您家里有人患过肺癌吗？

english: Have you recently travelled outside the country?
transliteration: nee dzway-jin chyoo-gwoh gwah-wye mah?
translation: 您最近去过国外吗？

english: I am going to listen to your lungs with a stethoscope.
transliteration: woh shyen-dzye yaow-yong ting-jehn-chee ting-ting nee-der fay-boo.
translation: 我现在要用听诊器听听您的肺部。

english: Please sit upright.
transliteration: ching dzwoh-jyew.
translation: 请坐直。

english: Please loosen your shirt so I can examine your chest.
transliteration: ching soh-kai yee-foo, fahn-byen woh jian-cha nee-der chwung-boo.
translation: 请松开衣服，方便我检查您的胸部。

english: Please breathe in deeply through your mouth.
transliteration: ching yong zoow shen-shee ee-kow-chee.
translation: 请用嘴深吸一口气。

english: Please breathe out slowly.
transliteration: ching mahhn-mahn hoo-chee.
translation: 请慢慢呼气。

english: Please hold your breath for a moment.
transliteration: ching ping-joo hoo-shee ee-hwair.
translation: 请屏住呼吸一会儿。

english: Please cough for me.
transliteration: ching kow-show ee-shyah.
translation: 请咳嗽一下。

english: I am going to check your oxygen level with this finger clip.
transliteration: woh shyen-dzye yaow-yong jay-guh jya dzai shoo-jir-shahng-der jya-dzuh jian-cha nee-der hyweh-yahng shway-ping.
translation: 我现在要用这个夹在手指上的夹子检查您的血氧水平。

english: I am going to count how many breaths you take in a minute.
transliteration: woh shyen-dzye yaow shew-yee-shew nee ee-fen-jwung hoo-shee jee-tsee.
translation: 我现在要数一数您一分钟呼吸几次。

english: I am going to gently tap on your back.
transliteration: woh shyen-dzye yaow ching-ching kow-ee-kow nee-der bay-boo.
translation: 我现在要轻轻叩一叩您的背部。

english: Does it hurt when I press here?
transliteration: woh ahn jay-lee-der shrr-how, nee hway tayng mah?
translation: 我按这里的时候，您会疼吗？

english: We would like to do a chest X-ray.
transliteration: woh-men shyahng gay nee pah ee-jahng chwung-boo X gwahng-pyan.
translation: 我们想给您拍一张胸部X光片。

english: Have you had a chest X-ray before?
transliteration: nee yee-chyen pah-gwoh chwung-boo X gwahng-pyan mah?
translation: 您以前拍过胸部X光片吗？

english: We may need a CT scan of your chest.
transliteration: woh-men kuh-neng shoo-yaow gay nee dzwoh chwung-boo CT sao-myow.
translation: 我们可能需要给您做胸部CT扫描。

english: We would like to check your blood oxygen level.
transliteration: woh-men shyahng jian-cha nee-der hyweh-yahng shway-ping.
translation: 我们想检查您的血氧水平。

english: We need to take a blood sample.
transliteration: woh-men shoo-yaow chow ee-dyen hyweh.
translation: 我们需要抽一点血。

english: We would like to test a sample of your sputum.
transliteration: woh-men shyahng jian-cha ee-shyah nee-der tahn-yay yang-ben.
translation: 我们想检查一下您的痰液样本。

english: We would like to measure how well your lungs work.
transliteration: woh-men shyahng tsay ee-shyah nee-der fay gung-neng.
translation: 我们想测一下您的肺功能。

english: Please blow out as hard and fast as you can into this tube.
transliteration: ching dwye-juh jay-guh gwahn-dzuh jeen kuh-neng yong-lee, kwai-suh-der hoo-chee.
translation: 请对着这个管子尽可能用力、快速地呼气。

english: We may need to do a sleep study.
transliteration: woh-men kuh-neng shoo-yaow way nee dzwoh shway-myahn jian-cha.
translation: 我们可能需要为您做睡眠检查。

english: We may need to look inside your airways with a small camera.
transliteration: woh-men kuh-neng shoo-yaow yong ee-guh shyow shyang-jyahng-tow kan-kan nee-der chee-dow lee-myen.
translation: 我们可能需要用一个小摄像头看看您的气道里面。

english: We will give you oxygen to help you breathe.
transliteration: woh-men hway gay nee shee-yahng, bang-joo nee hoo-shee.
translation: 我们会给您吸氧，帮助您呼吸。

english: This inhaler helps open your airways.
transliteration: jay-guh shee-yahng-chee kuh-yee bang-joo dah-kai nee-der chee-dow.
translation: 这个吸入器可以帮助打开您的气道。

english: I will show you how to use your inhaler.
transliteration: woh hway jyaw nee jen-muh shee-yong shee-yahng-chee.
translation: 我会教您怎么使用吸入器。

english: Please follow the dose written on your prescription.
transliteration: ching ahn-jaw choo-fahng-shahng shee-dur-der jee-lyahng shee-yong.
translation: 请按照处方上写的剂量使用。

english: Do not change the dose without speaking to your healthcare team.
transliteration: mey-yow hee nee-der yee-lyow twahn-dway gout-wung chyahn, ching boo-yaow guy-byahn jee-lyahng.
translation: 没有和您的医疗团队沟通前，请不要改变剂量。

english: Please rinse your mouth after using this steroid inhaler.
transliteration: shee-yong jay-jung lway-goo-chwun shee-yahng-chee how, ching shoo-kow.
translation: 使用这种类固醇吸入器后，请漱口。

english: We can help you make a plan to stop smoking.
transliteration: woh-men kuh-yee bang nee dzhee-ding jee-yen jih-yahw.
translation: 我们可以帮您制定戒烟计划。

english: Please wear a mask as instructed.
transliteration: ching ahn-jaw jee-shee dai kow-jaw.
translation: 请按照指示戴口罩。

english: Seek urgent medical care if your breathing becomes severely difficult.
transliteration: roo-gwoh nee hoo-shee fey-chahng kuh-nahn, ching lee-jah jee-yeeow.
translation: 如果您呼吸非常困难，请立即就医。

english: Seek urgent medical care if you cough up a large amount of blood.
transliteration: roo-gwoh nee kow-choo hen-dwaw hyweh, ching lee-jah jee-yeeow.
translation: 如果您咳出很多血，请立即就医。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: nee yow shen-muh wen-tee mah?
translation: 您有什么问题吗？

english: Can you tell me how you will use your inhaler at home?
transliteration: nee neng gow-soo woh dzai jya hway jen-muh shee-yong shee-yahng-chee mah?
translation: 您能告诉我在家会怎么使用吸入器吗？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: woh-men hway way nee ahn-pai ee-tsuh foo-jin.
translation: 我们会为您安排一次复诊。

english: We may refer you to a lung specialist.
transliteration: woh-men kuh-neng hway jwan-jin nee chyoo kan fay-kaw jwun-kaw yee-sheng.
translation: 我们可能会转诊您去看肺科专科医生。

english: Please return if your symptoms get worse.
transliteration: roo-gwoh nee-der jung-jwahng jya-jwung, ching hwuy-lai jee-jin.
translation: 如果您的症状加重，请回来就诊。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: shyeh-shyeh nee jin-tyan gen woh tahn-hwah.
translation: 谢谢您今天和我谈话。

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.
transliteration: nee-how, woh shr nee-der yee-lyow twahn-dway cherng-ywen jr-yee.
translation: 您好，我是您的医疗团队成员之一。

english: What brought you here today?
transliteration: jin-tyan shr shen-muh ywen-yin rang nee lai jay-lee?
translation: 今天是什么原因让您来这里？

english: I would like to ask some questions about your stomach and digestion.
transliteration: woh shyahng wen nee ee-shee goan-yoo wei-boo uh shway-hwah-der wen-tee.
translation: 我想问您一些关于胃部和消化的问题。

english: What is worrying you the most?
transliteration: nee dzway dahn-shin-der shr shen-muh?
translation: 您最担心的是什么？

english: May I examine your abdomen?
transliteration: woh kuh-yee jian-cha nee-der foo-boo mah?
translation: 我可以检查您的腹部吗？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: roo-gwoh yow ren-huh de-fahng tayng, ching gow-soo woh.
translation: 如果有任何地方疼，请告诉我。

english: Do you need an interpreter?
transliteration: nee shoo-yaow kow-yee-ywen mah?
translation: 您需要口译员吗？

english: When did your symptoms begin?
transliteration: nee-der jung-jwahng shr shen-muh shr-how kai-shrr-der?
translation: 您的症状是什么时候开始的？

english: Did the problem start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: wen-tee shr twah-ran chway-shyen-der, hay-shrr mahhn-mahn kai-shrr-der?
translation: 问题是突然出现的，还是慢慢开始的？

english: How long have you had this problem?
transliteration: jay-guh wen-tee chr-shew dwaw-jyew-der?
translation: 这个问题持续多久了？

english: Is it getting better or worse?
transliteration: ching-kwahng shr dzai how-jwan hay-shrr dzai jya-jwung?
translation: 情况是在好转还是在加重？

english: Does it come and go?
transliteration: jay-jung ching-kwahng hway shr-how how-shr-how hwai mah?
translation: 这种情况会时好时坏吗？

english: Have you had this problem before?
transliteration: nee yee-chyen yow-gwoh jay-guh wen-tee mah?
translation: 您以前有过这个问题吗？

english: Does it wake you up at night?
transliteration: jay hway rang nee yeh-lee shyeng-lai mah?
translation: 这会让您夜里醒来吗？

english: Do you have pain in your abdomen?
transliteration: nee-der foo-boo tayng mah?
translation: 您的腹部疼吗？

english: Where exactly does it hurt?
transliteration: juh-tee nahr-lee tayng?
translation: 具体哪里疼？

english: Please point to where it hurts most.
transliteration: ching jr-choo dzway tayng-der de-fahng.
translation: 请指出最疼的地方。

english: Is the pain in the upper or lower abdomen?
transliteration: tayng-twong shr dzai shahng foo-boo hay-shrr shyah foo-boo?
translation: 疼痛是在上腹部还是下腹部？

english: Is the pain on the right or left side?
transliteration: tayng-twong shr dzai yow-byan hay-shrr dzwoh-byan?
translation: 疼痛是在右边还是左边？

english: Is the pain around your belly button?
transliteration: doo-jee chow-way tayng mah?
translation: 肚脐周围疼吗？

english: Does the pain spread to your back or shoulder?
transliteration: tayng-twong hway yen-shen dow bay-boo uh jian-bahng mah?
translation: 疼痛会延伸到背部或肩膀吗？

english: Is the pain sharp, dull, burning, or cramping?
transliteration: tayng-twong shr tsz-twong, yin-twong, jwoo-twong, hay-shrr jyow-twong?
translation: 疼痛是刺痛、隐痛、灼痛还是绞痛？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: ching tsong ling dow shrh gay tayng-twong dah-fen, shrh dah-byaw dzway tayng.
translation: 请从零到十给疼痛打分，十代表最痛。

english: Is the pain constant or does it come and go?
transliteration: tayng-twong shr ee-jrr chr-shew, hay-shrr shr-yow-shrr woo?
translation: 疼痛是一直持续，还是时有时无？

english: Did the pain move from one area to another?
transliteration: tayng-twong tsong ee-guh de-fahng yee-dow ling ee-guh de-fahng le mah?
translation: 疼痛从一个地方移到另一个地方了吗？

english: Does eating make the pain better or worse?
transliteration: chee-dong-shee hway rang tayng-twong how ee-shee, hay-shrr geng yen-jwung?
translation: 吃东西会让疼痛好一些还是更严重？

english: Is the pain worse after a fatty meal?
transliteration: chee-yoow-nee-der fahn-tsai how tayng-twong hway jya-jwung mah?
translation: 吃油腻的饭菜后疼痛会加重吗？

english: Does drinking milk make your symptoms worse?
transliteration: hoo new-nai hway rang nee-der jung-jwahng jya-jwung mah?
translation: 喝牛奶会让您的症状加重吗？

english: Do spicy foods make your symptoms worse?
transliteration: chee shin-lah shr-woo hway rang nee-der jung-jwahng jya-jwung mah?
translation: 吃辛辣食物会让您的症状加重吗？

english: Does the pain improve after passing stool?
transliteration: pai-ben how tayng-twong hway jyen-ching mah?
translation: 排便后疼痛会减轻吗？

english: Does passing gas relieve the pain?
transliteration: pai-chee how tayng-twong hway jyen-ching mah?
translation: 排气后疼痛会减轻吗？

english: Does movement or coughing make the pain worse?
transliteration: hwuh-dong uh kow-show hway rang tayng-twong jya-jwung mah?
translation: 活动或咳嗽会让疼痛加重吗？

english: Does lying down make the pain worse?
transliteration: tahng-shyah hway rang tayng-twong jya-jwung mah?
translation: 躺下会让疼痛加重吗？

english: What makes the pain feel better?
transliteration: shen-muh neng rang tayng-twong how ee-shee?
translation: 什么能让疼痛好一些？

english: Do you feel nauseated or sick to your stomach?
transliteration: nee jyew-der wuh-shin uh fan-wei mah?
translation: 您觉得恶心或反胃吗？

english: Have you vomited?
transliteration: nee two-gwoh mah?
translation: 您吐过吗？

english: How many times have you vomited today?
transliteration: nee jin-tyan two-ler jee-tsr?
translation: 您今天吐了几次？

english: Can you keep food and fluids down?
transliteration: nee neng chee-dong-shee, hew-shway bing boo two choo-lai mah?
translation: 您能吃东西、喝水并不吐出来吗？

english: Is there blood in your vomit?
transliteration: nee-der ow-two-woo lee yow hyweh mah?
translation: 您的呕吐物里有血吗？

english: Does your vomit look like coffee grounds?
transliteration: nee-der ow-two-woo kan-chi-lai shyahng koh-fay-jah mah?
translation: 您的呕吐物看起来像咖啡渣吗？

english: Is your vomit green or yellow?
transliteration: nee-der ow-two-woo shr luh-suh uh hwahng-suh-der mah?
translation: 您的呕吐物是绿色或黄色的吗？

english: Do you vomit after eating?
transliteration: nee chee-wahn dong-shee how hway two mah?
translation: 您吃完东西后会吐吗？

english: When did you last vomit?
transliteration: nee shahng-ee-tsr two shr shen-muh shr-how?
translation: 您上一次吐是什么时候？

english: How often do you have a bowel movement?
transliteration: nee dwaw-jyew pai-ee-tsr dah-ben?
translation: 您多久排一次大便？

english: Have your bowel habits changed recently?
transliteration: nee dzway-jin-der pai-ben shee-guan yow byahn-hwah mah?
translation: 您最近的排便习惯有变化吗？

english: When was your last bowel movement?
transliteration: nee shahng-ee-tsr pai-ben shr shen-muh shr-how?
translation: 您上一次排便是什么时候？

english: Is your stool hard or soft?
transliteration: nee-der dah-ben shr ying-der hay-shrr roow-der?
translation: 您的大便是硬的还是软的？

english: Is your stool watery or loose?
transliteration: nee-der dah-ben shr shway-yahng-der hay-shrr shee-der?
translation: 您的大便是水样的还是稀的？

english: Is your stool black or tar-like?

english: Please lie down on your back.

transliteration: woh shyen-dzye yaow ching-ching ahn-yah nee-der foo-boo.

transliteration: woh ahn jay-lee-der shr-how, roo-gwoh nee jyew-der tayng, ching gow-soo woh.

english: Does it hurt more when I let go?

english: I may need to examine your rectum, and I will explain why first.

english: We would like to do some blood tests.

english: We need a stool sample.

english: A colonoscopy uses a camera to look inside your large intestine.

english: You may need to take bowel preparation before the colonoscopy.

english: You may need to avoid eating or drinking before the procedure.

english: We will explain the risks and ask for your consent before the procedure.
transliteration: jian-cha chyahn, woh-men hway shyahng nee jee-shrr feng-shyen bing jeng-chiw nee-der tong-yee.

english: Take small sips of water frequently.

english: Do not take painkillers such as ibuprofen unless your clinician advises it.

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.

english: Hello, I am part of your healthcare team.

translation: 您有没有突然无法控制大小便？

english: Have you been vomiting and unable to keep fluids down?
transliteration: NIN yoh-MAY-yoh ee-JEE oh-TU, hee-shya-CHU duh yeh-TEE yeh loo bu-JHOO?
translation: 您有没有一直呕吐，喝下去的液体也留不住？

english: Please lie down on your back.
transliteration: ching yang-WOH tang-shya.
translation: 请仰卧躺下。

english: I will examine your abdomen and lower back.
transliteration: woh hwuy jian-CHA NIN duh fuh-BUuh han shya-BAY-buh.
translation: 我会检查您的腹部和下背部。

english: Please point to the area that hurts.
transliteration: ching jhee-CHU TONG-tong duh di-FANG.
translation: 请指出疼痛的地方。

english: I will press gently on your lower abdomen.
transliteration: woh hwuy ching-ching an-YA NIN duh shya-FUH-buh.
translation: 我会轻轻按压您的下腹部。

english: Tell me if it hurts when I press here.
transliteration: woh an JEH-lee shih, roo-GWOH NIN JWAY-duh TONG, ching GOH-su woh.
translation: 我按这里时，如果您觉得疼，请告诉我。

english: I am going to tap gently on your back near the kidneys.
transliteration: woh hwuy dzai NIN kao-JIN shen-ZANG duh BAY-buh ching-ching kou jee-shya.
translation: 我会在您靠近肾脏的背部轻轻叩几下。

english: I may need to examine your genital area; I will explain and ask permission first.
transliteration: woh kuh-NUNG SHU-YAO jian-CHA NIN duh sheng-JHIH boo-WAY. woh hwuy shyen SHYANG NIN jye-SHAO bing jheng-CHYU NIN duh tong-YEE.
translation: 我可能需要检查您的生殖器部位。我会先向您解释并征求您的同意。

english: Please tell me immediately if anything hurts.
transliteration: roo-GWOH yoh REN-huh di-FANG TONG, ching ma-SHANG GOH-su woh.
translation: 如果有任何地方疼，请马上告诉我。

english: We can pause or stop the examination at any time.
transliteration: jian-CHA guo-CHENG-JHONG, NIN shee-SH-HOU kuh-YEE YAO-chyOO TING-DUN OR TING-jhee.
translation: 检查过程中，您随时可以要求暂停或停止。

english: A prostate examination may be helpful; I will explain it first.
transliteration: jian-CHA chyEN-lee-SHYEN kuh-NUNG yoh bang-JOO, woh hwuy shyen SHYANG NIN jye-SHAO.
translation: 检查前列腺可能会有帮助，我会先向您解释。

english: The prostate examination may involve a gloved finger in the rectum.
transliteration: chyEN-lee-SHYEN jian-CHA kuh-NUNG SHU-YAO dai SHOU-tao duh shy-GEE shen-RU jy-JHANG.
translation: 前列腺检查可能需要戴手套的手指伸入直肠。

english: Is it okay to proceed with this examination?
transliteration: NIN tong-YEE woh-MUN jin-HANG JEH-shyang jian-CHA muh?
translation: 您同意我们进行这项检查吗？

english: Would you like a chaperone for this examination?
transliteration: NIN SHYANG yoh-ren pei-TONG NIN dzwoh JEH-shyang jian-CHA muh?
translation: 您希望有人陪同您做这项检查吗？

english: Please turn onto your side.
transliteration: ching tseh-SHEN tang.
translation: 请侧身躺。

english: Please bend your knees toward your chest.
transliteration: ching ba syi-GAI wan-CHYI-LAI, kao-JIN SYUNG-kow.
translation: 请把膝盖弯起来，靠近胸口。

english: I will check for swelling or tenderness in the scrotum.
transliteration: woh hwuy jian-CHA NIN duh yin-NANG yoh-MAY-yoh JHONG-JHANG OR ya-TONG.
translation: 我会检查您的阴囊有没有肿胀或压痛。

english: Please cough while I examine your groin.
transliteration: woh jian-CHA NIN fuh-GOO shih, ching KAO-sh ee-shya.
translation: 我检查您腹股沟时，请咳嗽一下。

english: We need a urine sample.
transliteration: woh-MUN SHU-YAO ee-fen nyow-YEE-yang-bun.
translation: 我们需要一份尿液样本。

english: Please collect urine in this clean container.
transliteration: ching ba nyow-YEE show-JEE dzai JEH-guh gan-JING duh rong-CHYI-lee.
translation: 请把尿液收集在这个干净的容器里。

english: We will test your urine for infection and blood.
transliteration: woh-MUN hwuy jian-CHA NIN duh nyow-YEE, KAN yoh-MAY-yoh GAN-RAN han SHYEE.
translation: 我们会检查您的尿液，看有没有感染和血。

english: We may send the urine for a culture.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG hwuy ba nyow-YEE song-CHYU dzwoh pei-YANG jian-CHA.
translation: 我们可能会把尿液送去做培养检查。

english: We would like to check your kidney function with blood tests.
transliteration: woh-MUN SHYANG tung-GWOH yan-SHYEE jian-CHA NIN duh shen-GONG-nung.
translation: 我们想通过验血检查您的肾功能。

english: We may arrange an ultrasound of your kidneys and bladder.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG hwuy an-PAI NIN dzwoh shen-ZANG han pang-GWANG CHAO-sheng jian-CHA.
translation: 我们可能会安排您做肾脏和膀胱超声检查。

english: We may need a CT scan to look for kidney stones.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG SHU-YAO GEI NIN dzwoh CEE-TEE sao-MIAO, jian-CHA yoh-MAY-yoh shen-JEE-shih.
translation: 我们可能需要给您做CT扫描，检查有没有肾结石。

english: We may check how much urine remains in your bladder after you urinate.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG hwuy jian-CHA NIN PAI-nyow HOU pang-GWANG-lee HAI sheng-doo-SHAO nyow.
translation: 我们可能会检查您排尿后膀胱里还剩多少尿。

english: We may need a camera examination of the bladder called cystoscopy.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG SHU-YAO yong pang-GWANG-jing jian-CHA pang-GWANG.
translation: 我们可能需要用膀胱镜检查膀胱。

english: We may need to give you antibiotics.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG SHU-YAO GEI NIN yong kang-sheng-SOO.
translation: 我们可能需要给您用抗生素。

english: Please take this medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: ching YAN-guh an-JHAO chuh-FANG fuh-YONG JEH-jhong YAO.
translation: 请严格按照处方服用这种药。

english: You may need a catheter to drain your bladder.
transliteration: NIN kuh-NUNG SHU-YAO yong dao-NYAO-guan yin-LYO pang-GWANG-lee duh nyow-YEE.
translation: 您可能需要用导尿管引流膀胱里的尿液。

english: We will explain the catheter procedure and ask for your consent.
transliteration: woh-MUN hwuy SHYANG NIN jye-SHAO dao-NYAO-guan tsao-DZWOH, bing jheng-CHYU NIN duh tong-YEE.
translation: 我们会向您解释导尿管操作，并征求您的同意。

english: Please keep the catheter bag below the level of your bladder.
transliteration: ching ba dao-NYAO-DAI fang dzai dee-YOO pang-GWANG duh WAI-jhee.
translation: 请把导尿袋放在低于膀胱的位置。

english: You may need to strain your urine to collect a stone.
transliteration: NIN kuh-NUNG SHU-YAO yong LOO-wang guo-LYUH nyow-YEE, show-JEE shih-KWOW.
translation: 您可能需要用滤网过滤尿液，收集结石。

english: We may refer you to a urologist.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG hwuy jhuan-JIN NIN CHYU KAN mee-NYAO-koh yee-SHENG.
translation: 我们可能会转诊您去看泌尿科医生。

english: We may refer you to a kidney specialist.
transliteration: woh-MUN kuh-NUNG hwuy jhuan-JIN NIN CHYU KAN shen-ZANG jhuan-KOH yee-SHENG.
translation: 我们可能会转诊您去看肾脏专科医生。

english: If you cannot urinate or develop severe pain or fever, seek urgent care.
transliteration: roo-GWOH NIN woo-FAH pai-NYAO, OR chwayn-SHYEN joo-LYAY TONG-tong OR fah-SHAO, ching LEE-JEE jyoh-YEE.
translation: 如果您无法排尿，或出现剧烈疼痛或发烧，请立即就医。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: NIN yoh SHEM-MUH wun-TIH muh?
translation: 您有什么问题吗？

english: Can you tell me which symptoms would need urgent medical attention?
transliteration: NIN nung goh-SWAH woh, chwayn-SHYEN nay-SHYAH JHUNG-JWANG shih SHU-YAO jin-JEE jyoh-YEE muh?
translation: 您能告诉我，出现哪些症状时需要紧急就医吗？

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: woh-MUN hwuy way NIN an-PAI fuh-JIN.
translation: 我们会为您安排复诊。

english: Please return if your symptoms worsen.
transliteration: roo-GWOH NIN duh JHUNG-JWANG gah-JHONG, ching hwuy-LAI jyoh-JIN.
translation: 如果您的症状加重，请回来就诊。

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: SHYAY-SHYAY NIN jin-TYAN han woh jyaow-LYO.
translation: 谢谢您今天和我交流。

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: NIN jin-TYAN way-SHEM-MUH lai KAN-bing?
translation: 您今天为什么来看病？

english: When did your symptoms start?
transliteration: NIN duh JHUNG-JWANG shih-SHEN-MUH sh-KAI-sh duh?
translation: 您的症状是什么时候开始的？

english: Have your symptoms been getting worse?
transliteration: NIN duh JHUNG-JWANG dzway-JIN gah-JHONG le muh?
translation: 您的症状最近加重了吗？

english: Do you have any other symptoms?
transliteration: NIN HAI-yoh chee-ta JHUNG-JWANG muh?
translation: 您还有其他症状吗？

english: May I ask about your medical history?
transliteration: woh kuh-YEE wun ee-shya NIN duh bing-SHY?
translation: 我可以问一下您的病史吗？

english: May I examine you?
transliteration: woh kuh-YEE GEI NIN dzwoh jian-CHA muh?
translation: 我可以给您做检查吗？

english: Would you like an interpreter?
transliteration: NIN SHU-YAO KOW-yee-yun muh?
translation: 您需要口译员吗？

english: Have you been diagnosed with diabetes?
transliteration: yee-SHENG jyen-DWAN-gwoh NIN HWAHN-yoh TAHNG-nyow-BING muh?
translation: 医生诊断过您患有糖尿病吗？

english: Do you have type 1 or type 2 diabetes?
transliteration: NIN HWAHN duh shih ee-SYING HAI-shih ar-SYING TAHNG-nyow-BING?
translation: 您患的是1型还是2型糖尿病？

english: How long have you had diabetes?
transliteration: NIN HWAHN TAHNG-nyow-BING doo-JYAO duh?
translation: 您患糖尿病多久了？

english: Are you more thirsty than usual?
transliteration: NIN bee-PING-shih geng rong-YEE KOW-jyoo muh?
translation: 您比平时更容易口渴吗？

english: Are you urinating more often?
transliteration: NIN dzway-JIN shyow-BYEN-TSUH-shoo geng doo muh?
translation: 您最近小便次数更多了吗？

english: Do you wake up at night to urinate?
transliteration: NIN WAN-shang hwuy CHYI-chuang shyow-BYEN muh?
translation: 您晚上会起床小便吗？

english: Have you lost weight without trying?
transliteration: NIN yoh-MAY-yoh dzai may-YOU KAY-ee jian-FAY duh KWAY-kwahng ching-KWANG shya, tee-JHONG jian-QING?
translation: 您有没有在没有刻意减肥的情况下体重下降？

english: Do you feel more hungry than usual?
transliteration: NIN bee-PING-shih geng rong-YEE JWAY-duh uh muh?
translation: 您比平时更容易觉得饿吗？

english: Have you noticed blurred vision?
transliteration: NIN yoh-MAY-yoh fah-SHYEN shy-LEE moo-HOO?
translation: 您有没有发现视力模糊？

english: Do you feel unusually tired?
transliteration: NIN JWAY-duh te-BYAY pee-JWAN muh?
translation: 您觉得特别疲倦吗？

english: Have you had frequent infections?
transliteration: NIN jing-CHANG GAN-RAN muh?
translation: 您经常感染吗？

english: Do your wounds take a long time to heal?
transliteration: NIN duh shang-KOW shih-BU-shih YAO HEN-JYOO TSAI yu-HEH?
translation: 您的伤口是不是很久才愈合？

english: Do you check your blood sugar at home?
transliteration: NIN dzai jya tser shy-HYEE muh?
translation: 您在家测血糖吗？

english: How often do you check your blood sugar?
transliteration: NIN doo-JYAO tser ee-TSUH shy-HYEE?
translation: 您多久测一次血糖？

english: What was your last blood sugar reading?
transliteration: NIN shang-TSUH tser duh shy-HYEE shih doo-SHAO?
translation: 您上次测的血糖是多少？

english: Do you use a continuous glucose monitor?
transliteration: NIN shy-yong lyan-SHOO shy-HYEE jian-TSUH yee muh?
translation: 您使用连续血糖监测仪吗？

english: Have you brought your glucose readings?
transliteration: NIN dai-LAI shy-HYEE jih-LOO le muh?
translation: 您带来血糖记录了吗？

english: Have you had an HbA1c blood test?
transliteration: NIN dzwoh-gwoh TAHNG-hwa shy-HONG-dan (HbA1c) shy-yee jian-CHA muh?
translation: 您做过糖化血红蛋白（HbA1c）血液检查吗？

english: We will check your blood sugar now.
transliteration: woh-MUN SHYEN-dzai GEI NIN tser ee-shya shy-HYEE.
translation: 我们现在给您测一下血糖。

english: Your blood sugar is higher than the target.
transliteration: NIN duh shy-HYEE bee moo-BYAOH jhee GAO.
translation: 您的血糖比目标值高。

english: Have you ever had low blood sugar?
transliteration: NIN yee-CHYAN yoh-GWOH dee shy-HYEE muh?
translation: 您以前有过低血糖吗？

english: Do you get shaky or sweaty when your sugar is low?
transliteration: NIN shy-HYEE dee shih hwuy JWAY-duh fah-DAO OR chway-HAN muh?
translation: 您血糖低时会觉得发抖或出汗吗？

english: Do you feel dizzy or confused when your sugar is low?
transliteration: NIN shy-HYEE dee shih hwuy JWAY-duh TOW-YUN OR yee-SHHEH bu-CHING muh?
translation: 您血糖低时会觉得头晕或意识不清吗？

english: Have you ever fainted because of low blood sugar?
transliteration: NIN yoh-MAY-yoh yin-WAY dee shy-HYEE yee-TZYU DAO-gwoh muh?
translation: 您有没有因为低血糖晕倒过？

english: What do you do when your blood sugar is low?
transliteration: shway-TANG dee duh SHIH-hou, nyen hway zen-muh dzoh?
translation: 血糖低的时候，您会怎么做？

english: Do you carry something sugary with you?
transliteration: nyen hway swee-SHEN dye ee-shyay HAN-tang duh dong-shee mah?
translation: 您会随身带一些含糖的东西吗？

english: Have you had very high blood sugar recently?
transliteration: nyen dzway-JIN yow-gwoh shway-TANG duh-BYAY gao duh CHING-kwang mah?
translation: 您最近有过血糖特别高的情况吗？

english: Have you had nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain?
transliteration: nyen yow uh-SHEEN, oo-TOO hoo-juh way-TONG mah?
translation: 您有恶心、呕吐或胃痛吗？

english: Are you breathing faster or deeper than usual?
transliteration: nyen hoo-SHEE duh bee ping-SHEE geng kwai hoo-juh geng shen mah?
translation: 您呼吸得比平时更快或更深吗？

english: Have you ever been hospitalized for diabetic ketoacidosis?
transliteration: nyen ee-CYAN yin tang-NYOW-bing tun-JING soo-AN dwoh-ZHONG joo-gwoh-yen mah?
translation: 您以前因糖尿病酮症酸中毒住过院吗？

english: What medicines do you take for diabetes?
transliteration: nyen chee shen-muh yow jway-LYOW tang-NYOW-bing?
translation: 您吃什么药治疗糖尿病？

english: Do you take diabetes tablets?
transliteration: nyen chee jway-LYOW tang-NYOW-bing duh yow-PYAN mah?
translation: 您吃治疗糖尿病的药片吗？

english: Do you use insulin?
transliteration: nyen shrr-YONG yin-DOO-soo-LIN mah?
translation: 您使用胰岛素吗？

english: How many units of insulin do you take?
transliteration: nyen may-TSUH yong doo-SHAO dan-WEE duh yin-DOO-soo-LIN?
translation: 您每次用多少单位的胰岛素？

english: When do you take your insulin?
transliteration: nyen shen-muh SHIH-hou yong yin-DOO-soo-LIN?
translation: 您什么时候用胰岛素？

english: Did you take your insulin today?
transliteration: nyen jin-TYAN yong yin-DOO-soo-LIN luh mah?
translation: 您今天用胰岛素了吗？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: nyen dzway-JIN low-yong-gwoh yow mah?
translation: 您最近漏用过药吗？

english: Do you use an insulin pen or pump?
transliteration: nyen yong yin-DOO-soo-LIN bee hay-SHOO yin-DOO-soo-LIN beng?
translation: 您用胰岛素笔还是胰岛素泵？

english: Where do you inject your insulin?
transliteration: nyen bah yin-DOO-soo-LIN joo-SHEH dzai-LEE?
translation: 您把胰岛素注射在哪里？

english: Do you rotate your injection sites?
transliteration: nyen hway loon-HWAN joo-SHEH boo-WEE mah?
translation: 您会轮换注射部位吗？

english: Have you had side effects from your medicines?
transliteration: nyen duh yow yin-chee-gwoh foo-ZOO-yong mah?
translation: 您的药引起过副作用吗？

english: Would you like me to show you how to inject insulin?
transliteration: nyen sheang-yow rang woh jyao nyen zen-muh joo-SHEH yin-DOO-soo-LIN mah?
translation: 您想让我教您怎么注射胰岛素吗？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling in your feet?
transliteration: nyen duh jyao yow mah-MOO hoo-juh tsuh-TONG duh gan-JYOW mah?
translation: 您的脚有麻木或刺痛的感觉吗？

english: Do you have burning pain in your feet?
transliteration: nyen duh jyao yow joo-TONG gan mah?
translation: 您的脚有灼痛感吗？

english: Have you noticed any sores on your feet?
transliteration: nyen joo-EE-doh jyao-shang yow SHANG-kow mah?
translation: 您注意到脚上有伤口吗？

english: Do you check your feet every day?
transliteration: nyen may-TYAN jian-CHA dzih-jee duh jyao mah?
translation: 您每天检查自己的脚吗？

english: Have you had a diabetic eye examination?
transliteration: nyen dzoh-gwoh tang-NYOW-bing yan-DEE jian-CHA mah?
translation: 您做过糖尿病眼底检查吗？

english: Has diabetes affected your kidneys?
transliteration: tang-NYOW-bing ying-sheang-doh nyen duh shen-ZANG luh mah?
translation: 糖尿病影响到您的肾脏了吗？

english: Have you had a heart attack or stroke?
transliteration: nyen day-gwoh sheen-ZANG-bing hoo-juh jhong-FOONG mah?
translation: 您得过心脏病或中风吗？

english: I am going to check the feeling in your feet.
transliteration: woh shian-dzai yow jian-CHA nyen jyao-shang duh gan-JYOW.
translation: 我现在要检查您脚上的感觉。

english: Can you feel this on your toes?
transliteration: nyen neng gan-JYOW-doh woh pong nyen duh jyao-JEE mah?
translation: 您能感觉到我碰您的脚趾吗？

english: Have you ever had a thyroid problem?
transliteration: nyen ee-CYAN yow-gwoh jya-jwang-SHEEN wen-TI mah?
translation: 您以前有过甲状腺问题吗？

english: Do you have an underactive thyroid?
transliteration: nyen duh jya-jwang-SHEEN gong-NENG jian-TOY mah?
translation: 您的甲状腺功能减退吗？

english: Do you have an overactive thyroid?
transliteration: nyen duh jya-jwang-SHEEN gong-NENG kang-JIN mah?
translation: 您的甲状腺功能亢进吗？

english: Do you feel unusually cold?
transliteration: nyen jway-duh ee-CHANG pay-LENG mah?
translation: 您觉得异常怕冷吗？

english: Do you feel unusually hot or sweaty?
transliteration: nyen jway-duh ee-CHANG reh hoo-juh choo-HAN hen-dwoh mah?
translation: 您觉得异常热或出汗很多吗？

english: Have you noticed your heart racing?
transliteration: nyen joo-EE-doh dzih-jee duh sheen-TYAO hen-kwai mah?
translation: 您注意到自己的心跳很快吗？

english: Have you noticed shaking in your hands?
transliteration: nyen joo-EE-doh dzih-jee duh shou dzai fah-DOO mah?
translation: 您注意到自己的手在发抖吗？

english: Have you been constipated?
transliteration: nyen yow bien-MEE mah?
translation: 您有便秘吗？

english: Have you been having frequent bowel movements?
transliteration: nyen dzway-JIN dah-bian TSUH-shoo hen-dwoh mah?
translation: 您最近大便次数很多吗？

english: Have you noticed swelling in your neck?
transliteration: nyen joo-EE-doh dzih-jee duh BOH-dzih zhung-chee-lai luh mah?
translation: 您注意到脖子肿起来了吗？

english: Is it difficult to swallow?
transliteration: nyen tun-YAN kun-NAN mah?
