transliteration: nyen jway-duh dzih-jee bee-SHEE chong-FU dzoh moo-shee-CHU mah?
translation: 您觉得自己必须重复做某些事情吗？

english: How many hours do you sleep each night?
transliteration: nyen may-WAN shui jee-guh xiao-SHEE?
translation: 您每晚睡几个小时？

english: Is it difficult to fall asleep?
transliteration: nyen shrr-FOO hen-NAN rroo-SHEE mah?
translation: 您是否很难入睡？

english: Do you wake up often during the night?
transliteration: nyen yeh-LEE jing-CHANG xing-LAI mah?
translation: 您夜里经常醒来吗？

english: Do you wake up earlier than you want to?
transliteration: nyen shrr-FOO hway bee dzih-jee sheang-yow duh SHIH-hou geng-ZAO xing-LAI mah?
translation: 您是否会比自己想要的时间更早醒来？

english: Do you feel rested in the morning?
transliteration: nyen zao-shang xing-LAI shih jway-duh shiu-SHEE gou luh mah?
translation: 您早上醒来时觉得休息够了吗？

english: Do you have nightmares?
transliteration: nyen dzoh-E mah?
translation: 您做噩梦吗？

english: Have you been sleeping much more than usual?
transliteration: nyen dzway-JIN shrr-FOO bee ping-SHEE shui duh dwoh hen-DUO mah?
translation: 您最近是否比平时睡得多很多？

english: Do you feel tired during the day?
transliteration: nyen bai-TYAN hway gan-DAO pee-JUAN mah?
translation: 您白天会感到疲倦吗？

english: Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic or excited?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow-gwoh jing-LEE hoo-juh shing-FEN cheng-DU ee-CHANG gao duh SHIH-hou?
translation: 您有没有过精力或兴奋程度异常高的时候？

english: Have you needed much less sleep without feeling tired?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow-gwoh shui duh shao hen-DUO chyo boo jway-duh lei duh SHIH-hou?
translation: 您有没有过睡得少很多却不觉得累的时候？

english: Have others said you were talking unusually fast?
transliteration: yow-ren shuo-gwoh nyen shuo-HWA su-du ee-CHANG kuai mah?
translation: 有人说过您说话速度异常快吗？

english: Have your thoughts been racing?
transliteration: nyen shrr-FOO jway-duh see-SHW shway-kwai mah?
translation: 您是否觉得思绪飞快？

english: Have you felt unusually confident or powerful?
transliteration: nyen shrr-FOO gan-DAO dzih-jee ee-CHANG dzih-XIN hoo-juh chiang-DA mah?
translation: 您是否感到自己异常自信或强大？

english: Have you spent more money than you intended?
transliteration: nyen hwa duh qian yow-mei-yow chao-GWO yuen-BEN da-SUAN duh shu-MOO?
translation: 您花的钱有没有超过原本打算的数目？

english: Have you taken unusual risks during these periods?
transliteration: dzai je-shyay SHI-CHY, nyen yow-mei-yow mao-gwoh ping-SHEE boo-hway mao duh FENG-xian?
translation: 在这些时期，您有没有冒过平时不会冒的风险？

english: How long did these periods last?
transliteration: je-shyay SHI-CHY chi-SHOO luh dwoh-JOO?
translation: 这些时期持续了多久？

english: Have you heard voices that others cannot hear?
transliteration: nyen ting-DAO-gwoh bie-ren ting-boo-DAO duh sheng-YIN mah?
translation: 您听到过别人听不到的声音吗？

english: Have you seen things that others cannot see?
transliteration: nyen kan-DAO-gwoh bie-ren kan-boo-DAO duh dong-SHE mah?
translation: 您看到过别人看不到的东西吗？

english: Do you feel that someone is watching or following you?
transliteration: nyen jway-duh yow-ren dzai jian-SHI hoo-juh gen-ZONG nyen mah?
translation: 您觉得有人在监视或跟踪您吗？

english: Do you feel that someone wants to harm you?
transliteration: nyen jway-duh yow-ren sheang SHANG-hai nyen mah?
translation: 您觉得有人想伤害您吗？

english: Do you feel your thoughts are being controlled?
transliteration: nyen jway-duh dzih-jee duh sheang-FA show-dao kong-ZHI mah?
translation: 您觉得自己的想法受到控制吗？

english: Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
transliteration: nei-shyay sheng-YIN yow-mei-yow jiao nyen chy dzoh shen-muh?
translation: 那些声音有没有叫您去做什么？

english: What do you think these experiences mean?
transliteration: nyen jway-duh je-shyay jing-LI yi-WAY joo-SHEN mah?
translation: 您觉得这些经历意味着什么？

english: Do these experiences frighten you?
transliteration: je-shyay jing-LI hway rang nyen gan-DAO hey-PA mah?
translation: 这些经历会让您害怕吗？

english: Sometimes when people feel overwhelmed, they think about death. Has that happened to you?
transliteration: yow-SHE, ren-men gan-DAO nan-ee cheng-SHOU shih hway sheang-dao si-WANG. nyen yow-gwoh jee-ZHONG ching-KWANG mah?
translation: 有时，人们感到难以承受时会想到死亡。您有过这种情况吗？

english: Have you wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow sheang-gwoh dzih-jee shui-jiao-hou zay-yee bu-YAO xing-LAI?
translation: 您有没有希望自己睡着后再也不要醒来？

english: Have you had thoughts of ending your life?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow sheang-gwoh jie-SHOO dzih-jee duh sheng-MING?
translation: 您有没有想过结束自己的生命？

english: Are you having those thoughts right now?
transliteration: nyen shian-dzai yow je-shyay sheang-FA mah?
translation: 您现在有这些想法吗？

english: Have you thought about how you might do it?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow sheang-gwoh kuh-NENG hway zen-muh dzoh?
translation: 您有没有想过可能会怎么做？

english: Have you made a plan to end your life?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow jhih-DING jie-SHOO dzih-jee sheng-MING duh jee-HWA?
translation: 您有没有制定结束自己生命的计划？

english: Do you have access to anything you might use to hurt yourself?
transliteration: nyen shrr-FOO neng na-DAO ren-HO kuh-NENG yong-lai shang-hai dzih-jee duh dong-SHE mah?
translation: 您是否能拿到任何可能用来伤害自己的东西？

english: Have you ever tried to end your life before?
transliteration: nyen ee-CYAN yow-mei-yow shrr-TOO jie-SHOO dzih-jee duh sheng-MING?
translation: 您以前有没有试图结束自己的生命？

english: Have you ever hurt yourself on purpose?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow goo-ee shang-hai-gwoh dzih-jee?
translation: 您有没有故意伤害过自己？

english: What has helped you stay safe so far?
transliteration: dao-MOO-chyan wei-SHE shen-muh bang-JOO nyen bao-CHY quan-CHYAN?
translation: 到目前为止，什么帮助您保持安全？

english: Is there someone you trust whom we can contact?
transliteration: yow-mei-yow nyen shrr-XIN, woh-men kuh-YEE lian-XI duh ren?
translation: 有没有您信任、我们可以联系的人？

english: I am concerned about your safety and want to help you stay safe.
transliteration: woh dan-XIN nyen duh an-CHYAN, ye sheang bang-JOO nyen que-BAO an-CHYAN.
translation: 我担心您的安全，也想帮助您确保安全。

english: Do you feel safe where you live?
transliteration: nyen zai zhu duh dee-FANG jway-duh an-CHYAN mah?
translation: 您在住的地方觉得安全吗？

english: Has anyone threatened or hurt you?
transliteration: yow-ren wei-XIE-gwoh nyen hoo-juh shang-hai-gwoh nyen mah?
translation: 有人威胁过您或伤害过您吗？

english: Are you afraid of anyone at home?
transliteration: nyen hey-PA jya-LEE duh mou-guh ren mah?
translation: 您害怕家里的某个人吗？

english: Have you had thoughts of hurting someone else?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow sheang-gwoh shang-hai bie-ren?
translation: 您有没有想过伤害别人？

english: Is there a particular person you are thinking about hurting?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow te-BYAY sheang shang-hai moo-GUH-ren?
translation: 您有没有特别想伤害某个人？

english: Do you have a plan to hurt anyone?
transliteration: nyen yow-mei-yow shang-hai bie-ren duh jee-HWA?
translation: 您有没有伤害别人的计划？

english: Are there children or other vulnerable people at home?
transliteration: jya-LEE yow hai-dzih hoo-juh chi-ta shu-YAO te-BYAY bao-HOO duh ren mah?
translation: 家里有孩子或其他需要特别保护的人吗？

english: Have you experienced something frightening or traumatic?
transliteration: nyen jing-LI-gwoh rang nyen hey-PA hoo-juh zao-cheng chuang-shang duh shih mah?
translation: 您经历过让您害怕或造成创伤的事情吗？

english: You do not have to share details before you are ready.
transliteration: nyen kuh-YEE deng zhun-BEI hao luh zay fen-XIANG shee-JEE.
translation: 您可以等准备好了再分享细节。

english: Do memories of that experience come back unexpectedly?
transliteration: na-duan jing-LI duh jee-YEE hway-boo-hway chu-CHY fang-yi-wai duh foo-XIAN chu-LAI?
translation: 那段经历的记忆会不会出乎意料地浮现出来？

english: Do you have nightmares about what happened?
transliteration: nyen hway-meng-dao fa-SHENG-gwoh duh shih mah?
translation: 您会梦到发生过的事情吗？

english: Do you avoid reminders of what happened?
transliteration: nyen hway boo-KAI rang nyen sheang-DAO na-jyan shih duh ren hoo-juh dong-SHE mah?
translation: 您会避开让您想起那件事的人或事物吗？

english: Do you feel constantly on guard or unsafe?
transliteration: nyen shrr-FOO zong-jway-duh shu-YAO bao-CHI jing-TI, hoo-juh gan-DAO boo an-CHYAN mah?
translation: 您是否总觉得需要保持警惕，或者感到不安全？

english: Do you sometimes feel disconnected from yourself or your surroundings?
transliteration: nyen yow-SHE hway jway-duh dzih-jee gen dzih-jee, hoo-juh jhou-wee huan-JING tuo-JIE mah?
translation: 您有时会觉得自己与自己或周围环境脱节吗？

english: Do you drink alcohol?
transliteration: nyen hee-JYOW mah?
translation: 您喝酒吗？

english: How often and how much do you drink?
transliteration: neen doo-jyoh huh ee-tsuh jyow? may-tsuh huh doo-shaow?
translation: 您多久喝一次酒？每次喝多少？

english: Have you wanted to cut down on drinking?
transliteration: neen yo-may-yo shee-ang gwoh shaow huh-dee-ahn jyow?
translation: 您有没有想过少喝点酒？

english: Has anyone expressed concern about your drinking?
transliteration: yo-ren dahn-sheen gwoh neen huh-jyow duh chyeng-kwang mah?
translation: 有人担心过您喝酒的情况吗？

english: Do you use cannabis?
transliteration: neen shway-yong dah-mah mah?
translation: 您使用大麻吗？

english: Do you use cocaine, opioids, or other drugs?
transliteration: neen shway-yong kuh-kah-yin, ah-pee-ahn lay yow-woo hoo-chuh duh-poo mah?
translation: 您使用可卡因、阿片类药物或其他毒品吗？

english: Have you ever injected drugs?
transliteration: neen ee-chyen joo-shay gwoh doo-poo mah?
translation: 您以前注射过毒品吗？

english: When did you last use alcohol or other substances?
transliteration: neen shang-tzuh huh-jyow hoo-shway-yong chee-tah woo-tzhyuh shuh-shuhma?
translation: 您上次喝酒或使用其他物质是什么时候？

english: Do you feel shaky or unwell when you stop using them?
transliteration: t-ting-shway-yong jay-shee woo-tzhyuh shee, neen hay duh-jway-fah-dow hoo-boo-shoo-fuh mah?
translation: 停止使用这些物质时，您会觉得发抖或不舒服吗？

english: Have you ever had a seizure during withdrawal?
transliteration: neen ee-chyen jay-twahn shee fah-jow gwoh dee-ahn-yeen mah?
translation: 您以前在戒断时发作过癫痫吗？

english: Would you like support to reduce or stop using substances?
transliteration: neen shee-ang hwuh-dahng joo-joo, jyen-shaow hoo-ting-jay-shway-yong jay-shee woo-tzhyuh mah?
translation: 您想获得帮助，减少或停止使用这些物质吗？

english: How do you feel about your eating habits?
transliteration: neen tzun-mee-kan tzeh-jee duh yin-sheh-shee-kwahn?
translation: 您怎么看自己的饮食习惯？

english: Do you worry a lot about your weight or body shape?
transliteration: neen chang-chang-dahn-sheen tzeh-jee duh tway-jung hoo-shun-tsyeh mah?
translation: 您常常担心自己的体重或身材吗？

english: Have you been skipping meals or restricting food?
transliteration: neen tzway-jin yo boo-chee-fahn hoo-han-jay-jin-shee mah?
translation: 您最近有不吃饭或限制进食吗？

english: Do you sometimes feel unable to stop eating?
transliteration: neen yo-shih-han juh-jway tzeh-jee kwan-joo-boo-joo duh-chee-dong-shee mah?
translation: 您有时会觉得自己控制不住地吃东西吗？

english: Have you made yourself vomit after eating?
transliteration: neen chee-wahn dong-shee hoo-hou, yo-gwoh tzeh-jee tsway-too duh chyeng-kwang mah?
translation: 您吃完东西后，有过自己催吐的情况吗？

english: Have you been exercising to compensate for eating?
transliteration: neen-hway-tong-gwoo dwan-leen lay mee-boo chee-dong-shee mah?
translation: 您会通过锻炼来弥补吃东西吗？

english: Have you had trouble paying attention?
transliteration: neen tzway-jin yo joo-yee-leen boo-jung-kwahn duh chyeng-kwang mah?
translation: 您最近有注意力不集中的情况吗？

english: Do you often forget appointments or tasks?
transliteration: neen jing-chang-wang-jee yo-jin hoo-yao-tzoo duh shee-chyeng mah?
translation: 您经常忘记约诊或要做的事情吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in your memory?
transliteration: neen joo-yee-dow tzeh-jee duh jee-yee-lee yo byen-hwah mah?
translation: 您注意到自己的记忆力有变化吗？

english: Do you find it difficult to organize tasks?
transliteration: neen jway-dow-an-pai shee-chyeng hen-kwan-nahn mah?
translation: 您觉得安排事情很困难吗？

english: Have you been feeling confused?
transliteration: neen tzway-jin jway-dow hoo-too mah?
translation: 您最近觉得糊涂吗？

english: Has anyone noticed a change in your behaviour?
transliteration: yo-ren joo-yee-dow neen duh-sheen-why yo byen-hwah mah?
translation: 有人注意到您的行为有变化吗？

english: Can you tell me your full name?
transliteration: neen neng-gow dahn-gow woo neen duh chwen-ming mah?
translation: 您能告诉我您的全名吗？

english: Can you tell me today’s date?
transliteration: neen neng-gow dahn-gow woo jeen-tyeahn shee jee-how mah?
translation: 您能告诉我今天是几号吗？

english: Can you tell me where we are right now?
transliteration: neen neng-gow dahn-gow woo woo-men sheen-tzai tzai nah-lee mah?
translation: 您能告诉我我们现在在哪里吗？

english: I will say three words; please repeat them.
transliteration: woo-hway-shwo san-guh-tzuh, ching neen chung-foo ee-byen.
translation: 我会说三个词，请您重复一遍。

english: Please try to remember those words for later.
transliteration: ching neen jin-leean jee-joo jay-shee-tzuh, show-hou woo-hway-zai-wahn neen.
translation: 请您尽量记住这些词，稍后我会再问您。

english: Can you tell me those three words now?
transliteration: neen sheen-tzai neng-gow dahn-gow woo nah-san-guh-tzuh mah?
translation: 您现在能告诉我那三个词吗？

english: Can you spell a word backwards?
transliteration: neen neng-gow bah ee-guh-tzuh dow-juh-pin chuh-lai mah?
translation: 您能把一个词倒着拼出来吗？

english: What do you think is causing these difficulties?
transliteration: neen jway-dow jay-shee-kun-nahn shee-shuhm yuen-yin tzow-cheng duh?
translation: 您觉得这些困难是什么原因造成的？

english: How would you describe your mood today?
transliteration: neen jeen-tyeahn duh sheen-chyeng tzun-mee-yang?
translation: 您今天的心情怎么样？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever seen a psychiatrist or counsellor?
transliteration: neen ee-chyen kan-gwoh jing-shen-koh yee-sheng hoo-hsin-lee tzoo-shun-shih mah?
translation: 您以前看过精神科医生或心理咨询师吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you ever been admitted to hospital for mental health care?
transliteration: neen ee-chyen yin-why-sheen-lee-jean-kang wen-tee joo-gwoh-yuan mah?
translation: 您以前因心理健康问题住过院吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Has anyone in your family had mental health difficulties?
transliteration: neen duh jya-ren-jung yo-ren yo-gwoh-sheen-lee-jean-kang fang-myean duh kun-nahn mah?
translation: 您的家人中有人有过心理健康方面的困难吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Do you have any medical conditions?
transliteration: neen yo ren-huh shen-tee-jee-bing mah?
translation: 您有任何身体疾病吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who do you live with?
transliteration: neen hoo-shei joo tzai ee-chee?
translation: 您和谁住在一起？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Who can you turn to for support?
transliteration: neen kuh-yee sheang-shei shun-chyo joo-joo mah?
translation: 您可以向谁寻求帮助？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Have you had recent financial or housing difficulties?
transliteration: neen tzway-jin tzai jing-jee hoo-joo-fahng fang-myean yow-dow-kun-nahn-le-mah?
translation: 您最近在经济或住房方面遇到困难了吗？

stage: Past history, family and social support
english: Are your relationships causing you stress?
transliteration: neen duh ren-jee kwan-shee rang neen gan-dow yo ya-lee mah?
translation: 您的人际关系让您感到有压力吗？

english: What medicines are you taking now?
transliteration: neen sheen-tzai tzai chee nay-shee-yow?
translation: 您现在在吃哪些药？

english: Do you take antidepressant medication?
transliteration: neen tzai fuh-yong k-ahng-yoo-yuh-yow mah?
translation: 您在服用抗抑郁药吗？

english: Do you take medicine for anxiety?
transliteration: neen tzai fuh-yong jee-lee-ahng-jiao-luh duh-yow mah?
translation: 您在服用治疗焦虑的药吗？

english: Do you take antipsychotic medication?
transliteration: neen tzai fuh-yong k-ahng-jing-shen-bing-yow mah?
translation: 您在服用抗精神病药吗？

english: Do you take a mood stabilizer?
transliteration: neen tzai fuh-yong sheen-jing-oon-ding-jee mah?
translation: 您在服用心境稳定剂吗？

english: Do you take sleeping pills or benzodiazepines?
transliteration: neen tzai fuh-yong an-myeen-yow hoo-ben-dway-jwoo-lee-yow-woo mah?
translation: 您在服用安眠药或苯二氮䓬类药物吗？

english: What dose do you take and how often?
transliteration: neen may-tzuh fuh-yong doo-shaow-jee-lahng? doo-jow fuh-yong ee-tzuh?
translation: 您每次服用多少剂量？多久服用一次？

english: How long have you been taking this medicine?
transliteration: neen fuh-yong jay-jung-yow doo-jow-le?
translation: 您服用这种药多久了？

english: Have you missed any doses recently?
transliteration: neen tzway-jin loh-fuh-yong gwoh-yow mah?
translation: 您最近漏服过药吗？

english: Has the medicine been helping?
transliteration: jay-jung-yow doo neen yo bahng-joo mah?
translation: 这种药对您有帮助吗？

english: Have you noticed any side effects?
transliteration: neen joo-yee-dow yo-shem-mee fuh-joo-yong mah?
translation: 您注意到有什么副作用吗？

english: Have you stopped any medication recently?
transliteration: neen tzway-jin ting-gwoh ren-huh-yow mah?
translation: 您最近停过任何药吗？

english: What are your goals for treatment?
transliteration: neen doo-jee-lee yo-shem-mee moo-byaow?
translation: 您对治疗有什么目标？

english: Would you be interested in talking therapy or counselling?
transliteration: neen doo-jway-shew tzeh-shew tan-hwah-jay-leeh hoo-sheen-lee-tsoo-shun mah?
translation: 您有兴趣接受谈话治疗或心理咨询吗？

english: We can discuss medication options together.
transliteration: woo-men kuh-yee ee-chee tao-loon yow-woo shean-tzeh.
translation: 我们可以一起讨论用药选择。

english: Some medicines take several weeks to work fully.
transliteration: yo-shee-yow shee-yow-jee-woo hay-neng chong-fen fah-hway-tzow-yong.
translation: 有些药需要几周才能充分发挥作用。

english: Please speak with your clinician before stopping medication.
transliteration: ting-yow chyen ching-sheen hoo-nee duh-yee-hoo-ryen-tahn-tahn.
translation: 停药前请先和您的医护人员谈谈。

english: Would you like us to involve a trusted family member?
transliteration: neen yuen-yee rang ee-why neen-sheen-ren duh jya-ren tsahn-yoo-jin-lai mah?
translation: 您愿意让一位您信任的家人参与进来吗？

english: We can make a plan for what to do if symptoms worsen.
transliteration: roo-gwoh jwang-jwang jya-jung, woo-men kuh-yee ee-chee-jay-ding ying-doo-jih-hwah.
translation: 如果症状加重，我们可以一起制定应对计划。

english: What concerns do you have about treatment?
transliteration: neen doo-jay-lyoo-woo-jee-yow-shem-mee goo-lyoo?
translation: 您对治疗有什么顾虑？

english: Do you feel safe going home today?
transliteration: neen jway-dow jeen-tyeahn hoo-jya an-chyuen mah?
translation: 您觉得今天回家安全吗？

english: Who could you call if you felt unsafe?
transliteration: roo-gwoh neen jway-dow boo-an-chyuen, kuh-yee gay-shei dah-dee-hwah?
translation: 如果您觉得不安全，可以给谁打电话？

english: Can we identify warning signs that things are getting worse?
transliteration: woo-men kuh-yee ee-chee-jow-chu chyeng-kwang-oo-hwah duh yew-jing-sheen-how mah?
translation: 我们可以一起找出情况恶化的预警信号吗？

english: If you are in immediate danger, seek emergency help.
transliteration: roo-gwoh neen jeang-myean-lin jin-jyoo-wee-shyen, ching-shee-chyo jee-joow-bang-joo.
translation: 如果您正面临紧急危险，请寻求急救帮助。

english: We can arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: woo-men kuh-yee-woo neen an-pai ee-tzuh-foo-jin.
translation: 我们可以为您安排一次复诊。

english: Would you like information about local support services?
transliteration: neen shee-ang-lee-jay-ben-dee duh-joo-chee-fuh-woo mah?
translation: 您想了解本地的支持服务吗？

english: Is there anything else you would like to ask?
transliteration: neen hay-yo-shem-mee shee-ang-wahn duh mah?
translation: 您还有什么想问的吗？

english: I am going to ask some questions about your symptoms.
transliteration: woo-jee-sheah-lai-hway-wahn neen ee-shee-yow-kwahn-jooahng duh-wen-tee.
translation: 我接下来会问您一些有关症状的问题。

english: When did your symptoms first begin?
transliteration: neen duh jooahng-jwang zway-zao-shem-meh shee-how-kai-shee duh?
translation: 您的症状最早是什么时候开始的？

english: Did the symptoms start suddenly or gradually?
transliteration: jooahng-jwang-shee-tow-ran-choo-sheahn duh, hay-shee-man-man-choo-sheahn duh?
translation: 症状是突然出现的，还是慢慢出现的？

english: What were you doing when this started?
transliteration: jooahng-jwang-kai-shee-shee, neen-jeng-zai-tzoo-shem-mee?
translation: 症状开始时，您正在做什么？

english: Are the symptoms constant or do they come and go?
transliteration: jooahng-jwang-shee-ee-jah-ee-joo, hay-shee-shee-yow-shee-woo?
translation: 症状是一直持续，还是时有时无？

english: How long does each episode last?
transliteration: may-tzuh-fah-tzow-hway-choo-sheahn-doo-jow?
translation: 每次发作会持续多久？

english: How many times a day or week does this happen?
transliteration: jay-jung-chyeng-kwang-may-tyeahn-hoo-may-jow-hway-fah-sheng-jee-tzuh?
translation: 这种情况每天或每周会发生几次？

english: Are your symptoms getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: neen duh jooahng-jwang-shee-zai-hao-zwan, jya-jung, hay-shee-may-yo byen-hwah?
translation: 您的症状是在好转、加重，还是没有变化？

english: Have you ever had this problem before?
transliteration: neen ee-chyen yo-gwoh jay-guh-wen-tee mah?
translation: 您以前有过这个问题吗？

english: Does anything make it better or worse?
transliteration: yo-shem-mee-hway-rang-chyeng-kwang-hao-zwan-hoo-jya-jung mah?
translation: 有什么会让情况好转或加重吗？

english: Please tell me immediately if you feel unwell during the examination.
transliteration: jyen-cha-gwo-cheng-jung, roo-gwoh neen jway-dow-boo-shoo-fuh, ching-ma-shahng-gow-sow-woo.
translation: 检查过程中，如果您觉得不舒服，请马上告诉我。

english: Did you suddenly develop weakness on one side of your body?
transliteration: neen-shen-tee-ee-tzeh-yo-may-yo-choo-ran-woo-lee mah?
translation: 您身体一侧有没有突然无力？

english: Did one side of your face suddenly droop?
transliteration: neen-dee-ee-tzeh-lian-yo-may-yo-choo-ran-shia-chwee mah?
translation: 您的一侧脸有没有突然下垂？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble speaking?
transliteration: neen-yo-may-yo-choo-ran-shwoh-hwah-kun-nahn mah?
translation: 您有没有突然说话困难？

english: Did you suddenly have trouble understanding speech?
transliteration: neen-yo-may-yo-choo-ran-ting-boo-doong-bay-ren-shwoh-duh-hwah mah?
translation: 您有没有突然听不懂别人说的话？

english: Did you suddenly lose vision in one or both eyes?
transliteration: neen-yo-may-yo-choo-ran-ee-jang-yan-hoo-shuang-yan-shee-ming mah?
translation: 您有没有突然一只眼或双眼失明？

english: Did you suddenly lose your balance or coordination?
transliteration: neen-yo-may-yo-choo-ran-shoo-choo-ping-heng-hoo-syeh-tiao-neng-lee mah?
translation: 您有没有突然失去平衡或协调能力？

english: What time were you last completely well?
transliteration: neen-zway-hou-ee-tzuh-wan-chuen-may-yo-boo-shoo-fuh-shee-shem-meh-she-how?
translation: 您最后一次完全没有不舒服是什么时候？

english: Did the symptoms go away completely?
transliteration: jooahng-jwang-yo-may-yo-wan-chuen-sheau-shee?
translation: 症状有没有完全消失？

english: Did you have the worst headache of your life?
transliteration: neen-yo-may-yo-jing-lee-gwoh-jeh-buh-tzeh-zway-yin-jung-duh-too-tong?
translation: 您有没有经历过这辈子最严重的头痛？

english: Did the headache reach maximum intensity within seconds or a minute?
transliteration: too-tong-yo-may-yo-zai-jee-meaow-hoo-ee-fun-jong-nei-dah-dow-zway-yin-jung-duh-cheng-doo?
translation: 头痛有没有在几秒钟或一分钟内达到最严重的程度？

english: Do you have a fever with a stiff neck?
transliteration: neen-fah-shaw-shee-boh-tzuh-jyeng-ying-mah?
translation: 您发烧时脖子僵硬吗？

english: Have you had a new seizure or lost consciousness?
transliteration: neen-tzway-jin-yo-may-yo-shin-fah-dee-ahn-yeen-fah-joe-hoo-shee-choo-yee-shee mah?
translation: 您最近有没有新发癫痫发作或失去意识？

english: Do you have new difficulty controlling your bladder or bowels?
transliteration: neen-tzway-jin-yo-may-yo-shin-choo-she-kwan-boo-joo-dah-shee-bian duh chyeng-kwang mah?
translation: 您最近有没有新出现控制不住大小便的情况？

english: Do you have numbness around your groin or buttocks?
transliteration: neen-duh-fahng-goo-hoo-too-bu-joo-wee-yo-mah-mah-gan-jway mah?
translation: 您的腹股沟或臀部周围有麻木感吗？

english: Where exactly is your headache?
transliteration: neen duh-too-tong-joo-tee-zai-nah-lee?
translation: 您的头痛具体在哪里？

english: Is the pain on one side or both sides of your head?
transliteration: neen duh-too-shee-ee-tzeh-tong hay-shee-lyahng-tzeh-dow-tong?
translation: 您的头是一侧痛还是两侧都痛？

english: Does the pain spread to your neck, face, or behind your eyes?
transliteration: too-tong-hway-kwoo-san-dow-neh-duh-boh-tzuh, lian-bu-hoo-yan-jing-how-myean mah?
translation: 疼痛会扩散到您的脖子、脸部或眼睛后面吗？

english: Is the pain throbbing, pressing, stabbing, or burning?
transliteration: too-tong-shee-tyaow-tong, ya-poh-tong, tseen-tong, hay-shee-joo-tong?
translation: 疼痛是跳痛、压迫痛、刺痛还是灼痛？

english: How severe is the pain from zero to ten?
transliteration: ching-yong-ling-dow-shee-fun-byao-shee, too-tong yo-doo-yin-jung?
translation: 请用0到10分表示，疼痛有多严重？

english: Does light or noise bother you during the headache?
transliteration: too-tong-shee, kwang-sheen-hoo-zaow-yin-hway-rang-neen-boo-shoo-fuh mah?
translation: 头痛时，光线或噪音会让您不舒服吗？

english: Do you feel nauseated or vomit with the headache?
transliteration: too-tong-shee-neen-hway-jway-dow-o-sheen-hoo-yo-too-tuh mah?
translation: 头痛时您会觉得恶心或呕吐吗？

english: Do you see flashing lights or zigzag lines before the headache?
transliteration: too-tong-chyen-neen-hway-kan-dow-shahng-gwang-hoo-jwoo-chee-jwang-seen-tyaow mah?
translation: 头痛前您会看到闪光或锯齿状线条吗？

english: Does physical activity make the headache worse?
transliteration: shen-tee-hwah-dong-hway-rang-too-tong-jya-jung mah?
translation: 身体活动会让头痛加重吗？

english: Does coughing, straining, or bending make it worse?
transliteration: ke-sow, yong-lee-hoo-wan-yaow-hway-rang-chyeng-kwang-byen-duh-geng-zao mah?
translation: 咳嗽、用力或弯腰会让情况变得更糟吗？

english: Is the headache worse when lying down or standing up?
transliteration: tang-shia-hoo-jahn-chi-lai-shee, too-tong-hway-geng-yin-jung mah?
translation: 躺下或站起来时，头痛会更严重吗？

english: Does the headache wake you from sleep?
transliteration: too-tong-hway-bah-neen-choong-shway-mung-jung-tong-shing mah?
translation: 头痛会把您从睡梦中痛醒吗？

english: Have your headaches changed recently?
transliteration: neen-tzway-jin-duh-too-tong-yo-byen-hwah mah?
translation: 您最近的头痛有变化吗？

english: How many days each month do you have a headache?
transliteration: neen-may-geh-yoo-yo-jee-tyeahn-hway-too-tong?
translation: 您每个月有几天会头痛？

english: How often do you take painkillers for headaches?
transliteration: neen-doo-chang-fuh-yong-jy-ting-yow-lai-huan-jay-too-tong?
translation: 您多常服用止痛药来缓解头痛？

english: Do you feel the room spinning or do you feel faint?
transliteration: neen-jway-dow-fahng-jean-zai-shwan-zwan, hay-shee-jway-dow-kway-yao-yun-dow?
translation: 您觉得房间在旋转，还是觉得快要晕倒？

english: Do you feel unsteady when walking?
transliteration: zow-loo-shee-nee-hway-jway-dow-jahn-boo-woo mah?
translation: 走路时您会觉得站不稳吗？

english: Does turning your head trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: zwan-too-hway-yin-fah-too-yun mah?
translation: 转头会引发头晕吗？

english: Does standing up trigger the dizziness?
transliteration: jahn-chi-lai-hway-yin-fah-too-yun mah?
translation: 站起来会引发头晕吗？

english: Does the dizziness last seconds, minutes, hours, or longer?
transliteration: too-yun-hway-choo-sheahn-jee-meaow, jee-fun-jong, jee-geh-shaow-shee, hay-shee-geng-jow?
translation: 头晕会持续几秒、几分钟、几小时，还是更久？

english: Do you have ringing in your ears or hearing loss?
transliteration: neen-yo-ere-ming-hoo-ting-lee-shia-jahng mah?
translation: 您有耳鸣或听力下降吗？

english: Have you fallen because of the dizziness?
transliteration: neen-yo-may-yo-yin-why-too-yun-er-shway-dow-gwoh mah?
translation: 您有没有因为头晕而摔倒过？

english: Can you walk without assistance?
transliteration: neen-boo-shoo-yao-bay-ren-bahng-mang-yee-neng-zow-loo mah?
translation: 您不需要别人帮忙也能走路吗？

english: Do you feel weakness in your arms or legs?
transliteration: neen-duh-show-bee-hoo-tway-hway-jway-dow-woo-lee mah?
translation: 您的手臂或腿会觉得无力吗？

english: Is one side weaker than the other?
transliteration: ee-tzeh-bee-ling-ee-tzeh-geng-woo-lee mah?
translation: 一侧比另一侧更无力吗？

english: Do you have trouble lifting your arms above your head?
transliteration: neen-bah-show-bee-ju-gwo-too-ding-shee-hway-jway-dow-kun-nahn mah?
translation: 您把手臂举过头顶时会觉得困难吗？

english: Do you have trouble standing up from a chair?
transliteration: neen-tzong-yee-dyee-shahng-jahn-chi-lai-hway-jway-dow-kun-nahn mah?
translation: 您从椅子上站起来会觉得困难吗？

english: Do you trip because your foot drags?
transliteration: neen-hway-yin-why-jyao-tow-joo-dee-zow-lu-er-pan-dow mah?
translation: 您会因为脚拖着地走而绊倒吗？

english: Do you drop objects from your hands?
transliteration: neen-show-lee-duh-doong-shee-hway-dyaw-shia-lai mah?
translation: 您手里的东西会掉下来吗？

english: Does the weakness get worse with repeated activity?
transliteration: fan-foo-hwah-dong-how, woo-lee-gan-hway-jya-jung mah?
translation: 反复活动后，无力感会加重吗？

english: Does resting improve the weakness?
transliteration: show-shee-how, woo-lee-gan-hway-hao-ee-shee mah?
translation: 休息后，无力感会好一些吗？

english: Have you noticed muscle twitching or cramps?
transliteration: neen-joo-yee-dow-jee-oo-chow-doong-hoo-chow-jin-le mah?
translation: 您注意到肌肉抽动或抽筋了吗？

english: Have your muscles become smaller over time?
transliteration: neen-duh-jee-oo-soo-jee-tyeahn-tway-shaow-le mah?
translation: 您的肌肉随着时间推移变小了吗？

english: Do you have numbness or tingling anywhere?
transliteration: neen-shen-tee-nah-lee-yo-mah-moo-hoo-tseen-tong-gan mah?
translation: 您身体哪里有麻木或刺痛感吗？

english: Where does the numbness begin and where does it spread?
transliteration: mah-moo-cong-nah-lee-kai-shee, yoo-kooh-san-dow-nah-lee?
translation: 麻木从哪里开始，又扩散到哪里？

english: Is the numbness in both hands or both feet?
transliteration: neen-duh-lyahng-jang-show-hoo-lyahng-jang-jyao-dow-yo-mah-moo-gan mah?
translation: 您的两只手或两只脚都有麻木感吗？

english: Do you feel burning or electric-shock-like pain?
transliteration: neen-hway-jway-dow-joo-tong, hoo-shee-shyng-chyo-dian-ee-yang-tong mah?
translation: 您会觉得灼痛，或像触电一样疼吗？

english: Does the pain travel from your back down your leg?
transliteration: too-tong-hway-cong-bee-bu-yahn-juh-tway-wahng-shia-yan-shen mah?
translation: 疼痛会从背部沿着腿往下延伸吗？

english: Can you feel hot and cold normally?
transliteration: neen-neng-jeng-chahng-gan-jway-leng-hoo-reh mah?
translation: 您能正常感觉冷热吗？

english: Does touching the skin cause unusual pain?
transliteration: choo-pung-pee-foo-hway-yin-chi-yih-chahng-too-tong mah?
translation: 触碰皮肤会引起异常疼痛吗？

english: Have you ever had a seizure or fit?
transliteration: neen-ee-chyen-yo-gwoh-dyahn-xian-fah-jow mah?
translation: 您以前有过癫痫发作吗？

english: Did anyone see what happened during the episode?
transliteration: fah-jow-shee-yo-ren-kan-dow-fah-sheng-le-shem-mee mah?
translation: 发作时有人看到发生了什么吗？

english: Did your arms or legs shake uncontrollably?
transliteration: neen-duh-show-bee-hoo-tway-dang-shee-yo-may-yo-boo-show-kong-jy-dong mah?
translation: 您的手臂或腿当时有没有不受控制地抽动？

english: Did you lose awareness of your surroundings?
transliteration: neen-dang-shee-yo-may-yo-shee-choo-doo-jow-ween-ging duh yee-shee mah?
translation: 您当时有没有失去对周围环境的意识？

english: Did you bite your tongue?
transliteration: neen-yow-dow-she-too-le mah?
translation: 您咬到舌头了吗？

english: Did you lose control of your bladder?
transliteration: neen-dang-shee-yo-may-yo-shee-choo-doo-pang-gwong duh kong-jy mah?
translation: 您当时有没有失去对膀胱的控制？

english: Were you confused or sleepy afterward?
transliteration: jyy-how neen-yo-may-yo-gan-dow-me-foo hoo-kun-joen mah?
translation: 之后您有没有感到迷糊或困倦？

english: Did you notice a strange smell, feeling, or warning before the episode?
transliteration: fah-jow-chyen, neen-yo-may-yo-wen-dow-guai-chyi duh-qi-wei, gan-dow-guai-chyi duh-gan-jway, hoo-choo-sheahn-yew-jing mah?
translation: 发作前，您有没有闻到奇怪的气味、感到奇怪的感觉，或出现预警？

english: How long did it take to return to normal?
transliteration: gwoh-le-doo-jow neen-tzai-hway-hf-foo-jeng-chahng?
translation: 过了多久您才恢复正常？

english: Have you missed any doses of your seizure medicine?
transliteration: neen duh k-ahng-dyan-yao yo-may-yo-loh-fuh-yong?
translation: 您的抗癫痫药有没有漏服？

english: Do your hands shake when resting or when using them?
transliteration: neen-duh-show tzai-show-shee-hoo-sher-yong-shee-hway-dah-dow mah?
translation: 您的手在休息时或使用时会发抖吗？

english: Does the shaking affect one hand or both?
transliteration: dah-dow-ying-sheahng-ee-tzeh-show hay-shee lyahng-tzeh-show?
translation: 发抖影响一只手还是两只手？

english: Has your handwriting become smaller?
transliteration: neen-duh-zy-jee-byen-shaow-le mah?
translation: 您的字迹变小了吗？

english: Do you feel stiff or move more slowly?
transliteration: neen-jway-dow-shen-tee-jang-ying-hoo-doong-jow-byen-man-le mah?
translation: 您觉得身体僵硬或动作变慢了吗？

english: Have you had difficulty starting to walk?
transliteration: neen-kai-shee-zow-loo-shee-hway-jway-dow-kun-nahn mah?
translation: 您开始走路时会觉得困难吗？

english: Do you freeze or feel stuck while walking?
transliteration: zow-loo-shee-neen-hway-choo-ran-mai-boo-kai-boo-hoo-jway-dow-bay-kah-joo mah?
translation: 走路时您会突然迈不开步或觉得被卡住吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in your voice or facial expression?
transliteration: neen-joo-yee-dow-sheen-yin-hoo-mian-bu-byao-chyeng-yo-byen-hwah mah?
translation: 您注意到声音或面部表情有变化吗？

english: Have you been forgetting recent conversations or appointments?
transliteration: neen-tzway-jin-chahng-wang-jee-tahn-gwoh-duh-hwah-hoo-yoo-hway mah?
translation: 您最近常忘记谈过的话或约会吗？

english: Do you have trouble finding the right words?
transliteration: neen-hway-jow-boo-dow-shih-ahng duh tzuh-lai-byao-dah mah?
translation: 您会找不到合适的词来表达吗？

english: Have you become lost in familiar places?
transliteration: neen-zai-shoo-shee duh-dee-fahng-yeh-hway-mee-loo mah?
translation: 您在熟悉的地方也会迷路吗？

english: Do you have difficulty managing medicines or finances?
transliteration: neen-guan-lee-yow-woo-hoo-tsai-woo-shee-hway-jway-dow-kun-nahn mah?
translation: 您管理药物或财务时会觉得困难吗？

english: Have you noticed changes in your mood or behaviour?
transliteration: neen-joo-yee-dow-tzeh-jee duh-ching-shoo-hoo-sheen-why yo-byen-hwah mah?
translation: 您注意到自己的情绪或行为有变化吗？

english: Do you have trouble concentrating?
transliteration: neen-hway-jway-dow-nahn-yee-jung-jong-joo-yee-lee mah?
translation: 您会觉得难以集中注意力吗？

english: Has your speech become slurred?
transliteration: neen-shwoh-hwah-byen-duh-han-hoo-boo-ching-choo-le mah?

english: Have you recently started, stopped, or changed a medicine?

english: Have you noticed any side effects?

english: Please puff out your cheeks.

english: Please squeeze my fingers.

english: Please push against my hand.
transliteration: ching yong lee twey my show
translation: 请用力推我的手。

english: Please pull against my hand.
transliteration: ching yong lee lah my show

english: Please bend your knee.

english: Please straighten your knee.

translation: 我检查您的感觉时，请闭上眼睛。

english: Can you feel me touching you here?
transliteration: wo pong jee-lee shrr, nee neng gahn-jway-dow mah?
translation: 我碰这里时，您能感觉到吗？

english: Does it feel the same on the left and right?
transliteration: dzwo byen huh yaw byen duh gahn-jway ee-yahng mah?
translation: 左边和右边的感觉一样吗？

english: Tell me whether this feels sharp or dull.
transliteration: ching gaw-su wo, jee gahn-jway shrr jyen-ruy haishrr chy-dun
translation: 请告诉我，这感觉是尖锐还是迟钝。

english: Tell me whether this feels warm or cold.
transliteration: ching gaw-su wo, jee gahn-jway shrr wun haishrr lyang

english: Tell me which way I move your finger or toe.
transliteration: ching gaw-su wo, wo bah nee-ung duh show-jrr how jyow-dzuh wang nweh-guh fang-shyang dong

english: Please let your arm or leg relax.
transliteration: ching fahng-song nee-ung duh show-bee-ow huh lay

english: Please touch your nose and then my finger.
transliteration: ching shyen mo nee-ung duh bee-dzuh, dzai mo my duh show-jrr

english: Please do that again a little faster.
transliteration: ching dzai dzwo ee-tsrr, shaw-wee kwai ee-deen

english: Please tap your hands on your thighs, turning them over quickly.

english: Please walk on your heels.
transliteration: ching yong jyow-gen dzow-lu

english: Please walk on your toes.
transliteration: ching deen-juh jyow-jyan dzow-lu
translation: 请踮着脚尖走路。

english: Please turn around and walk back.
transliteration: ching jwan-shen, ran-how dzow hway-lai
translation: 请转身，然后走回来。

english: We may need a CT scan of your head.
transliteration: wo-muhn kuh-neng shyu-yao gee nee-ung duh toe-boo dzoow CT scan

english: We may need an MRI scan of your brain or spine.

english: A nerve conduction study checks how your nerves send signals.

english: I will explain the benefits and risks before any procedure.

transliteration: jee-shyoo jr-chy-en, nee-ung yaw shen-muh wun-tyi mah?

english: Please take your medicines exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: ching yan-ger an-jaw chyoo-fang foo-yao

english: Do not stop seizure medicines suddenly without medical advice.

english: Seek emergency care for sudden weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe sudden headache.

translation: 如果突然感到无力、说话困难或突然剧烈头痛，请立即去急诊。

english: Hello. I am here to examine your eyes.

english: What brings you in today?
transliteration: nee-ung jin-tyen wei shen-muh lai kan-jyen?

english: Please sit here.
transliteration: ching dzwo dzai jee-lee
translation: 请坐在这里。

english: Which eye is bothering you?
transliteration: nah jrr yen-jing rang nee-ung boo shoo-foo?
translation: 哪只眼睛让您不舒服？

english: Is it one eye or both eyes?
transliteration: shrr ee-jrr yen-jing boo shoo-foo, haishrr lyahng-jrr dou boo shoo-foo?
translation: 是一只眼睛不舒服，还是两只都不舒服？

english: When did the problem start?
transliteration: je-guh wun-tyi shrr shen-muh shrr-hou kay-shrr duh?
translation: 这个问题是什么时候开始的？

english: May I examine your eyes?
transliteration: wo kuh-yee jyen-chah ee-shya nee-ung duh yen-jing mah?
translation: 我可以检查一下您的眼睛吗？

english: Please tell me if anything hurts.
transliteration: roo-goo yaw ren-how duh-fang teng, ching gaw-su wo
translation: 如果有任何地方疼，请告诉我。

english: How long has this been happening?
transliteration: je-jong chyng-kwang chy-shyu dwo-jow leh?
translation: 这种情况持续多久了？

english: How many days has this been happening?
transliteration: je-jong chyng-kwang chy-shyu jee-tyen leh?

english: Did it start suddenly or gradually?

english: How long does each episode last?

english: Does it last seconds, minutes, hours, or days?

english: Is it getting better, worse, or staying the same?
transliteration: chyng-kwang shrr dzai hao-jwan, byen-chah, haishrr mee-yow byen-hwa?
translation: 情况是在好转、变差，还是没有变化？

english: Has this happened before?
transliteration: yee-chyen fah-sheng guo je-jong chyng-kwang mah?
translation: 以前发生过这种情况吗？

english: Did you wake up with this problem?
transliteration: nee-ung shing-lai shrr jeow yaw je-guh wun-tyi mah?

english: Did it start after an injury or procedure?

english: Please sit still. I am going to look inside your ear.

english: I will gently pull your ear to see inside.

english: Tell me if this hurts.
transliteration: roo-gwo dzhe-lee teng, ching gow-soo wor.
translation: 如果这里疼，请告诉我。

english: I am going to check your hearing.
transliteration: wor yow jian-cha yee-shyah nee-dur ting-lee.
translation: 我要检查一下您的听力。

english: Cover one ear and repeat the words you hear.
transliteration: woo-joo yee-jr ur-dwor, ran-how choong-foo neen ting-dow duh tsrr.
translation: 捂住一只耳朵，然后重复您听到的词。

english: Tell me whether you hear the tuning fork on the left, right, or in the middle.
transliteration: ching gow-soo wor, neen ting-dow yin-cha duh shung-yin shrr dzai dzwo-byan, yo-byan, hay-shrr jheng-joong-jyan.

english: Tell me when you can no longer hear the sound.
transliteration: ting-boo-dow shung-yin shrr ching gow-soo wor.

english: I am going to examine your eardrum.
transliteration: wor yow jian-cha yee-shyah nee-dur ur-moh.
translation: 我要检查一下您的耳膜。

english: I am going to examine your nose.
transliteration: wor yow jian-cha yee-shyah nee-dur bee-dzuh.
translation: 我要检查一下您的鼻子。

english: Please breathe through your nose.
transliteration: ching yong bee-dzuh hoo-shrr.
translation: 请用鼻子呼吸。

english: Close one nostril and breathe through the other.
transliteration: ching ahn-joo yee-tsee bee-kong, yong ling yee-tsee hoo-shrr.

english: Open your mouth wide, please.

translation: 请把嘴张大。

english: Stick out your tongue, please.
transliteration: ching shen-chu shyeh-tow.
translation: 请伸出舌头。

english: Say “ah,” please.
transliteration: ching shwoh ah.
translation: 请说“啊”。

english: Move your tongue from side to side.
transliteration: ching bah shyeh-tow dzwo-yo yidong.
translation: 请把舌头左右移动。

english: I am going to feel your neck for any lumps.
transliteration: wor yow mo-mo nee-dur duh bow-dzuh, kan-kan yow-may-yow jong-kwai.
translation: 我要摸摸您的脖子，看看有没有肿块。

english: Please swallow once.
transliteration: ching toon-yen yee-tsee.
translation: 请吞咽一次。

english: Turn your head to the left, then to the right.
transliteration: ching syan bah tow jwahn-shyang dzwo-byan, dzai jwahn-shyang yo-byan.
translation: 请先把头转向左边，再转向右边。

english: We may need a formal hearing test.
transliteration: wor-men kwah-nyang shyoo-yaow way nee dzwoh yee-tsee jheng-shrr duh ting-lee jian-cha.
translation: 我们可能需要为您做一次正式的听力检查。

english: We may need a camera examination of your nose or throat.
transliteration: wor-men kwah-nyang shyoo-yaow yong shee-syang-tow jian-cha nee-dur duh bee-dzuh huo howng-lung.
translation: 我们可能需要用摄像头检查您的鼻子或喉咙。

english: I will gently pass a small flexible camera through your nose.

english: You may feel pressure or discomfort, but tell me if it is painful.

english: We may need a CT scan or MRI to look more closely.

english: We may need to take a small sample of tissue for testing.
transliteration: wor-men kwah-nyang shyoo-yaow chyoo yee-shyao-kwai dzhoo-jr dzwoh jian-cha.
translation: 我们可能需要取一小块组织做检查。

english: I am going to remove some earwax if it is safe to do so.
transliteration: roo-gwo an-chyuan duh hwah, wor hway bang nee ching-choo yee-shee ur-gou.
translation: 如果安全的话，我会帮您清除一些耳垢。

english: Please use the medicine exactly as prescribed.
transliteration: ching yen-guh an-jaw chuu-fah shrr-yong yaw-wuh.
translation: 请严格按照处方使用药物。

english: I will prescribe ear drops or a nasal spray if needed.
transliteration: roo-gwo shyoo-yaow, wor hway gei nee kai ur-yaw-shway huo nee-pen-jyee.
translation: 如果需要，我会给您开耳药水或鼻喷剂。

english: Keep your ear dry until we tell you otherwise.
transliteration: dzai wor-men ling-way tong-jr nee yee-chyan, ching bow-chrr ur-dwor gan-dzaw.
translation: 在我们另行通知您之前，请保持耳朵干燥。

english: Do not put cotton swabs or other objects inside your ear.
transliteration: ching boo-yaow bah myan-chyan huo chee-tah dong-shee faw-jin ur-dwor lee.
translation: 请不要把棉签或其他东西放进耳朵里。

english: If you have sudden hearing loss, seek urgent medical care.

translation: 请不要抓挠或抠皮肤。

english: Use a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer.
transliteration: ching shew yong wen her, woo shyahng way duh baw shur shwang.
translation: 请使用温和、无香味的保湿霜。

english: Keep the area clean and dry.
transliteration: ching bow chyr jee guh boo way ching jee gahn tsow.
translation: 请保持这个部位清洁干燥。

english: Avoid the product that seems to trigger the rash.
transliteration: ching bee myen shew yong sz hoo hwuy yin fah pee jen duh chan pin.
translation: 请避免使用似乎会引发皮疹的产品。

english: Use sunscreen and protect your skin from the sun.
transliteration: ching shew yong fang shai shwang bing bow hoo pee foo, bee myen yang gwang jow shay.
translation: 请使用防晒霜并保护皮肤，避免阳光照射。

english: The examination is finished. Thank you.
transliteration: jyen chah jye shoo luh. shye shye.
translation: 检查结束了。谢谢。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment.
transliteration: woh mun hwuy way neen an pai foo jyen.
translation: 我们会为您安排复诊。

english: Please return if the rash worsens or spreads.
transliteration: roo gwo pee jen jia jong or kwoh sahn, ching hwuy lai jyo jyen.
translation: 如果皮疹加重或扩散，请回来就诊。

english: Seek urgent medical care if you have trouble breathing or rapidly worsening symptoms.
transliteration: roo gwo neen hoo shee kwun nahn or jheng jwang soo kwai jia jong, ching lee jee jyou yee.
translation: 如果您呼吸困难或症状迅速加重，请立即就医。

english: We will use a professional interpreter to explain the results and treatment.
transliteration: woh mun hwuy ching jwen yeh kow yee yuen way neen jye shyh jyen chah jye gwo her jyo lyao fang an.
translation: 我们会请专业口译员为您解释检查结果和治疗方案。

english: What brings you in today?

english: Have you had this pain before?

english: Did you fall or have an accident?

english: When did the injury happen?

english: How did you injure yourself?

english: Did you continue playing or working after the injury?

english: Was this related to sports, work, or lifting something heavy?

english: Does it hurt more when you walk or stand?

english: Do you have stiffness in the morning?

english: Can you walk without assistance?

english: Does the joint lock, catch, or give way?

english: Is the area swollen?

english: Have you had unexplained weight loss?

english: Do you have pain or swelling in your fingers?

transliteration: zai ee-WOO TWEEM duh-DOOE gaw-SOO neen kuh-YEE an-CHYUEN jeen-SHR HWOH yin-SHOO jyee-CHYEN, ching BUH-YOW CHRR dung-SHEE HWOH HUH shway.
translation: 在医护团队告诉您可以安全进食和饮水之前，请不要吃东西或喝水。

english: Have you spoken with the anesthesiologist?
transliteration: neen HWOH mah-ZWAY yih-SHENG tan gwo le mah?
translation: 您和麻醉医生谈过了吗？

english: Is there any chance you could be pregnant?
transliteration: neen YOW kuh-NUNG HWAY HWAH-yun mah?
translation: 您有可能怀孕吗？

english: We will check your blood pressure and pulse.
transliteration: WOR-men HWAY tseh-LIANG neen duh SHYEH-yah HWOH MAI-bow.
translation: 我们会测量您的血压和脉搏。

english: We may give you fluids through a vein.
transliteration: WOR-men kuh-NUNG HWAY tung-GWOH jing-MAI GEI neen shoo-YEE.
translation: 我们可能会通过静脉给您输液。

english: I am going to check your wound.
transliteration: WOR shyen-ZAI YOW jyen-CHAH ee-shyah neen duh shang-KOW.
translation: 我现在要检查一下您的伤口。

english: Is the wound more painful than before?
transliteration: shang-KOW bee yee-CHYEN GENG tung le mah?
translation: 伤口比以前更疼了吗？

english: Have you noticed redness or swelling around the wound?
transliteration: neen jyoo-yee dow shang-KOW JOW-way fah-HUNG HWOH jung-ZHANG le mah?
translation: 您注意到伤口周围发红或肿胀了吗？

english: Is any pus coming from the wound?
transliteration: shang-KOW YOW nung lyoow choo-LAI mah?
translation: 伤口有脓流出来吗？

english: We will change the dressing.
transliteration: WOR-men HWAY GEI neen huan-YAO.
translation: 我们会给您换药。

english: Please keep the dressing clean and dry.
transliteration: ching BAO-chyr fuh-LYOW CHING-jye gin-ZAHO.
translation: 请保持敷料清洁干燥。

english: We will remove the stitches when the wound has healed enough.
transliteration: shang-KOW yu-HEH duh CHAH-bu-dwoh how, WOR-men HWAY CHAI-shyen.
translation: 伤口愈合得差不多后，我们会拆线。

english: Is the drain collecting fluid?
transliteration: yin-LOW-guan lee YOW yeh-TEE mah?
translation: 引流管里有液体吗？

english: How is your pain since the operation?
transliteration: show-SHOO how neen duh tung-TONG zhen-MUH-yang?
translation: 手术后您的疼痛怎么样？

english: Have you been able to eat or drink?
transliteration: neen kuh-YEE CHRR dung-SHEE HWOH HUH shway le mah?
translation: 您能吃东西或喝水了吗？

english: Have you felt nauseated or vomited?
transliteration: neen jyweh-DUH OW-sheen HWOH TOO gwo mah?
translation: 您觉得恶心或吐过吗？

english: Have you passed gas since surgery?
transliteration: show-SHOO how neen PAI gwo-gee le mah?
translation: 手术后您排过气了吗？

english: Have you passed stool since surgery?
transliteration: show-SHOO how neen PAI gwo dah-BYEN le mah?
translation: 手术后您排过大便了吗？

english: Have you been able to get out of bed and walk?
transliteration: neen kuh-YEE shah-CHWANG zow-DONG le mah?
translation: 您能下床走动了吗？

english: Have you had any trouble passing urine?
transliteration: neen PAI-NEE YOW kun-NAN mah?
translation: 您排尿有困难吗？

english: Please ask for help before getting up if you feel dizzy.
transliteration: roo-GWOR neen jyweh-DUH tow-YUN, chee-SHEN chyEN ching shyen CHYOOW-joo.
translation: 如果您觉得头晕，起身前请先求助。

english: Do you have severe or worsening abdominal pain?
transliteration: neen YOW YEN-jung HWOH yue-LAI-yue-JUNG duh foo-TONG mah?
translation: 您有严重或越来越重的腹痛吗？

english: Have you been vomiting repeatedly?
transliteration: neen fan-FUH ou-TUO le mah?
translation: 您反复呕吐了吗？

english: Are you unable to pass gas or stool?
transliteration: neen WOO-fa PAI-gee HWOH PAI-byen mah?
translation: 您无法排气或排便吗？

english: Do you have a fever or chills?
transliteration: neen FAH-shao HWOH fa-CHEN mah?
translation: 您发烧或发冷吗？

english: Is the wound bleeding heavily?
transliteration: shang-KOW DAH-liang choo-SHYEH mah?
translation: 伤口大量出血吗？

english: Do you have chest pain or trouble breathing?
transliteration: neen SHOONG-tong HWOH HOO-she fan-NAN mah?
translation: 您胸痛或呼吸困难吗？

english: Have you fainted or felt very dizzy?
transliteration: neen YUN-dao gwo HWOH jyweh-DUH FEI-chang tow-YUN mah?
translation: 您晕倒过或觉得非常头晕吗？

english: If these symptoms occur, seek emergency medical care.
transliteration: roo-GWOR choo-SHYEN JAY-shee jhwang-JWANG, ching lee-KER shyun-CHYOOW JI-jyen yee-LYOW jyoow-JOO.
translation: 如果出现这些症状，请立即寻求急诊医疗救助。

english: We will arrange a follow-up appointment with the surgical team.
transliteration: WOR-men HWAY way neen an-PAI yue WAI-koh duh-DWAY duh fuh-JEN.
translation: 我们会为您安排与外科团队的复诊。

english: We may refer you to a cancer specialist.
transliteration: WOR-men kuh-NUNG HWAY way neen zhuan-JEN GEI ai-JENG jwoo-JEN yee-SHENG.
translation: 我们可能会为您转诊给癌症专科医生。

english: Please come back if the wound becomes red, swollen, or painful.
transliteration: roo-GWOR shang-KOW fah-HUNG, jung-ZHANG HWOH tung-TONG, ching HWEY-lai jee-CHEN.
translation: 如果伤口发红、肿胀或疼痛，请回来就诊。

english: Do you have any questions?
transliteration: neen YOW shen-MUH wen-TIH mah?
translation: 您有什么问题吗？

english: Can you explain how you will care for the wound at home?
transliteration: neen nung SHYANG-shyang zai JAH-lee YAO zhen-MUH hoo-LEE shang-KOW mah?
translation: 您能说说在家要怎么护理伤口吗？

english: Thank you for speaking with me today.
transliteration: SHYEH-shyeh neen jin-TYEN HWOH wor jyah-TAN.
translation: 谢谢您今天和我交谈。
